int Position::evaluate() const {
    int score = 0;
    for (int sq = 0; sq < 128; sq++) {
        if (sq & 0x88) continue;
        int p = board[sq];
        if (p == 0) continue;
        int color = p >> 3;
        int type = p & 7;
        
        int sign = (color == WHITE) ? 1 : -1;
        int tableSq = (color == WHITE) ? sq : (sq ^ 0x70);
        
        int val = 0;
        switch(type) {
            case PAWN: val = 100 + pawnEvalWhite[tableSq]; break;
            case KNIGHT: val = 320 + knightEval[tableSq]; break;
            case BISHOP: val = 330 + bishopEval[tableSq]; break;
            case ROOK: val = 500 + rookEval[tableSq]; break;
            case QUEEN: val = 900 + queenEval[tableSq]; break;
            case KING: val = 20000 + kingEval[tableSq]; break;
        }
        score += sign * val;
    }
    return (sideToMove == WHITE) ? score : -score;
}

const int MATE_SCORE = 100000;
atomic<long long> nodes{0};
atomic<bool> timeOver{false};
auto startTime = chrono::steady_clock::now();
int timeLimitMs = 0;

int negamax(const Position& pos, int depth, int alpha, int beta) {
    if ((nodes.fetch_add(1, memory_order_relaxed) & 2047) == 0) {
        auto now = chrono::steady_clock::now();
        int elapsed = chrono::duration_cast<chrono::milliseconds>(now - startTime).count();
        if (elapsed > timeLimitMs) timeOver.store(true, memory_order_relaxed);
    }
    if (timeOver.load(memory_order_relaxed)) return 0;
    
    if (depth == 0) {
        return pos.evaluate();
    }
    
    vector<Move> moves = getLegalMoves(pos);
    
    if (moves.empty()) {
        int kingColor = pos.sideToMove;
        int kingSq = -1;
        for (int sq = 0; sq < 128; sq++) {
            if ((sq & 0x88) == 0 && pos.board[sq] == (kingColor * 8 + KING)) {
                kingSq = sq;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (pos.isAttacked(kingSq, kingColor ^ 1)) {
            return -MATE_SCORE + (100 - depth); 
        } else {
            return 0; 
        }
    }
    
    sort(moves.begin(), moves.end(), [](const Move& a, const Move& b) {
        int scoreA = (a.captured != 0) ? 10 : (a.promotion != 0 ? 5 : 0);
        int scoreB = (b.captured != 0) ? 10 : (b.promotion != 0 ? 5 : 0);
        return scoreA > scoreB;
    });
    
    int bestScore = -1e9;
    bool first = true;
    for (const Move& m : moves) {
        Position next = doMove(pos, m);
        int score;
        if (first) {
            score = -negamax(next, depth - 1, -beta, -alpha);
            first = false;
        } else {
            score = -negamax(next, depth - 1, -alpha - 1, -alpha);
            if (score > alpha && score < beta && !timeOver.load(memory_order_relaxed)) {
                score = -negamax(next, depth - 1, -beta, -alpha);
            }
        }
        
        if (timeOver.load(memory_order_relaxed)) return 0;
        
        if (score > bestScore) {
            bestScore = score;
        }
        if (score > alpha) {
            alpha = score;
        }
        if (alpha >= beta) {
            break; 
        }
    }
    
    return bestScore;
}

Move findBestMove(const Position& pos, int maxTimeMs) {
    startTime = chrono::steady_clock::now();
    timeLimitMs = maxTimeMs;
    timeOver.store(false, memory_order_relaxed);
    nodes.store(0, memory_order_relaxed);
    
    vector<Move> rootMoves = getLegalMoves(pos);
    if (rootMoves.empty()) return Move(); 
    
    Move bestMove = rootMoves[0];
    
    for (int depth = 1; depth <= 100; depth++) {
        sort(rootMoves.begin(), rootMoves.end(), [&](const Move& a, const Move& b) {
            if (a.from == bestMove.from && a.to == bestMove.to) return true;
            if (b.from == bestMove.from && b.to == bestMove.to) return false;
            int scoreA = (a.captured != 0) ? 10 : (a.promotion != 0 ? 5 : 0);
            int scoreB = (b.captured != 0) ? 10 : (b.promotion != 0 ? 5 : 0);
            return scoreA > scoreB;
        });

        int bestScore = -1e9;
        Move currentBestMove = rootMoves[0];
        
        Position next = doMove(pos, rootMoves[0]);
        bestScore = -negamax(next, depth - 1, -1e9, 1e9);
        currentBestMove = rootMoves[0];
        
        if (timeOver.load(memory_order_relaxed)) break;
        
        int alpha = bestScore;
        atomic<int> sharedAlpha{alpha};
        
        struct MoveScore { Move m; int score; };
        vector<future<MoveScore>> futures;
        
        for (size_t i = 1; i < rootMoves.size(); i++) {
            Move m = rootMoves[i];
            futures.push_back(async(launch::async, [&, m, depth]() {
                int currentAlpha = sharedAlpha.load(memory_order_relaxed);
                Position nextPos = doMove(pos, m);
                
                int score = -negamax(nextPos, depth - 1, -currentAlpha - 1, -currentAlpha);
                
                if (score > currentAlpha && !timeOver.load(memory_order_relaxed)) {
                    score = -negamax(nextPos, depth - 1, -1e9, -currentAlpha);
                }
                
                return MoveScore{m, score};
            }));
        }
        
        bool depthFinished = true;
        for (auto& f : futures) {
            MoveScore ms = f.get();
            if (timeOver.load(memory_order_relaxed)) {
                depthFinished = false;
            } else {
                if (ms.score > bestScore) {
                    bestScore = ms.score;
                    currentBestMove = ms.m;
                    int currentAlpha = sharedAlpha.load(memory_order_relaxed);
                    while (bestScore > currentAlpha && !sharedAlpha.compare_exchange_weak(currentAlpha, bestScore)) {}
                }
            }
        }
        
        if (!depthFinished && depth > 1) break;
        bestMove = currentBestMove;
        
        if (bestScore > 90000) break; 
    }
    
    return bestMove;
}

Position parseFEN(const string& fen) {
    Position pos;
    for(int i=0; i<128; i++) pos.board[i] = 0;
    pos.epSquare = -1;
    pos.castlingRights = 0;
    
    stringstream ss(fen);
    string boardPart, sidePart, castlingPart, epPart, halfPart, fullPart;
    ss >> boardPart >> sidePart >> castlingPart >> epPart >> halfPart >> fullPart;
    
    int rank = 7;
    int file = 0;
    for (char c : boardPart) {
        if (c == '/') {
            rank--;
            file = 0;
        } else if (isdigit(c)) {
            file += (c - '0');
        } else {
            int color = isupper(c) ? WHITE : BLACK;
            int type = 0;
            char lc = tolower(c);
            if (lc == 'p') type = PAWN;
            else if (lc == 'n') type = KNIGHT;
            else if (lc == 'b') type = BISHOP;
            else if (lc == 'r') type = ROOK;
            else if (lc == 'q') type = QUEEN;
            else if (lc == 'k') type = KING;
            
            pos.board[rank * 16 + file] = color * 8 + type;
            file++;
        }
    }
    
    pos.sideToMove = (sidePart == "w") ? WHITE : BLACK;
    
    if (castlingPart != "-") {
        for (char c : castlingPart) {
            if (c == 'K') pos.castlingRights |= 1;
            if (c == 'Q') pos.castlingRights |= 2;
            if (c == 'k') pos.castlingRights |= 4;
            if (c == 'q') pos.castlingRights |= 8;
        }
    }
    
    if (epPart != "-") {
        int f = epPart[0] - 'a';
        int r = epPart[1] - '1';
        pos.epSquare = r * 16 + f;
    }
    
    return pos;
}

int main() {
    int timeout;
    if (!(cin >> timeout)) return 0;
    
    string fen_board, fen_side, fen_castling, fen_ep, fen_half, fen_full;
    if (!(cin >> fen_board >> fen_side >> fen_castling >> fen_ep >> fen_half >> fen_full)) {
        return 0;
    }
    
    string fen = fen_board + " " + fen_side + " " + fen_castling + " " + fen_ep + " " + fen_half + " " + fen_full;
    Position pos = parseFEN(fen);
    
    int timeLimitMs = (timeout * 1000) - 200; 
    if (timeLimitMs < 1000) timeLimitMs = 1000;
    
    Move bestMove = findBestMove(pos, timeLimitMs);
    
    cout << moveToString(bestMove, pos) << endl;
    
    return 0;
}

const fs = require('fs');

function dist(p1, p2) {
  const dx = p1.x - p2.x;
  const dy = p1.y - p2.y;
  return Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
}

function reverseSubarray(arr, i, j) {
  while (i < j) {
    const temp = arr[i];
    arr[i] = arr[j];
    arr[j] = temp;
    i++;
    j--;
  }
}

function getTourDist(depot, tour) {
  if (tour.length === 0) return 0;
  let total = dist(depot, tour[0]);
  for (let i = 0; i < tour.length - 1; i++) {
    total += dist(tour[i], tour[i + 1]);
  }
  total += dist(tour[tour.length - 1], depot);
  return total;
}

function optimize2Opt(depot, tour) {
  const L = tour.length;
  let improved = true;
  let iterations = 0;
  const maxIterations = L > 1000 ? 5 : (L > 500 ? 10 : 100);
  const W = L > 500 ? 50 : L;
  
  const refined = tour.slice();
  
  while (improved && iterations < maxIterations) {
    improved = false;
    iterations++;
    for (let i = 0; i < L; i++) {
      const prev = i === 0 ? depot : refined[i - 1];
      const end = Math.min(L - 1, i + W);
      for (let j = i + 1; j <= end; j++) {
        const next = j === L - 1 ? depot : refined[j + 1];
        
        const oldCost = dist(prev, refined[i]) + dist(refined[j], next);
        const newCost = dist(prev, refined[j]) + dist(refined[i], next);
        
        if (newCost < oldCost - 1e-9) {
          reverseSubarray(refined, i, j);
          improved = true;
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return refined;
}

function solveTSP(depot, packages, run2Opt = true) {
  if (packages.length === 0) return [];
  if (packages.length === 1) return [packages[0].id];
  
  // Try Candidate 1: Nearest Neighbor
  let tour1 = [];
  {
    const visited = new Set();
    let current = depot;
    for (let i = 0; i < packages.length; i++) {
      let bestDist = Infinity;
      let bestIdx = -1;
      for (let j = 0; j < packages.length; j++) {
        if (visited.has(j)) continue;
        const d = dist(current, packages[j]);
        if (d < bestDist) {
          bestDist = d;
          bestIdx = j;
        }
      }
      tour1.push(packages[bestIdx]);
      visited.add(bestIdx);
      current = packages[bestIdx];
    }
  }
  
  // Try Candidate 2: Angular Sort
  let tour2 = packages.slice().sort((a, b) => {
    const angleA = Math.atan2(a.y - depot.y, a.x - depot.x);
    const angleB = Math.atan2(b.y - depot.y, b.x - depot.x);
    return angleA - angleB;
  });
  
  if (run2Opt) {
    tour1 = optimize2Opt(depot, tour1);
    tour2 = optimize2Opt(depot, tour2);
  }
  
  const dist1 = getTourDist(depot, tour1);
  const dist2 = getTourDist(depot, tour2);
  
  const bestTour = dist1 < dist2 ? tour1 : tour2;
  return bestTour.map(p => p.id);
}

function getAdjustedAngle(angle, offset) {
  let diff = angle - offset;
  diff = diff % (2 * Math.PI);
  if (diff < 0) diff += 2 * Math.PI;
  return diff;
}

// 1. Angular Sweep VRP Solver
function runSweep(depot, packages, K, offsetCount = 16) {
  const N = packages.length;
  if (N === 0) return [];
  
  const packagesWithAngles = packages.map(p => {
    const angle = Math.atan2(p.y - depot.y, p.x - depot.x);
    return { p, angle };
  });
  
  let bestOffset = 0;
  let bestDist = Infinity;
  
  for (let step = 0; step < offsetCount; step++) {
    const offset = (2 * Math.PI * step) / offsetCount;
    
    packagesWithAngles.sort((a, b) => {
      return getAdjustedAngle(a.angle, offset) - getAdjustedAngle(b.angle, offset);
    });
    
    const routes = [];
    let startIdx = 0;
    for (let k = 0; k < K; k++) {
      const size = Math.floor(N / K) + (k < (N % K) ? 1 : 0);
      const clusterPackages = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < size; i++) {
        clusterPackages.push(packagesWithAngles[startIdx + i].p);
      }
      startIdx += size;
      
      const route = solveTSP(depot, clusterPackages, false);
      routes.push(route);
    }
    
    const packagesMap = new Map(packages.map(p => [p.id, p]));
    const totalDist = computeTotalDistance(routes, depot, packagesMap);
    if (totalDist < bestDist) {
      bestDist = totalDist;
      bestOffset = offset;
    }
  }
  
  packagesWithAngles.sort((a, b) => {
    return getAdjustedAngle(a.angle, bestOffset) - getAdjustedAngle(b.angle, bestOffset);
  });
  
  const finalRoutes = [];
  let startIdx = 0;
  for (let k = 0; k < K; k++) {
    const size = Math.floor(N / K) + (k < (N % K) ? 1 : 0);
    const clusterPackages = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < size; i++) {
      clusterPackages.push(packagesWithAngles[startIdx + i].p);
    }
    startIdx += size;
    
    const route = solveTSP(depot, clusterPackages, true);
    finalRoutes.push(route);
  }
  
  return finalRoutes;
}

// 2. K-Means VRP Solver
function runKMeans(depot, packages, K, maxKMeansIterations = 15) {
  const N = packages.length;
  if (N === 0) return [];
  if (K >= N) {
    return packages.map(p => [p.id]);
  }
  
  const centroids = [];
  centroids.push({ x: packages[0].x, y: packages[0].y });
  const chosen = new Set([0]);
  
  const minDistSq = new Array(N).fill(Infinity);
  for (let k = 1; k < K; k++) {
    const prevCentroid = centroids[k - 1];
    let bestIdx = -1;
    let maxDist = -1;
    for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
      if (chosen.has(i)) continue;
      const dSq = Math.pow(packages[i].x - prevCentroid.x, 2) + Math.pow(packages[i].y - prevCentroid.y, 2);
      if (dSq < minDistSq[i]) {
        minDistSq[i] = dSq;
      }
      if (minDistSq[i] > maxDist) {
        maxDist = minDistSq[i];
        bestIdx = i;
      }
    }
    if (bestIdx === -1) {
      for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
        if (!chosen.has(i)) {
          bestIdx = i;
          break;
        }
      }
    }
    centroids.push({ x: packages[bestIdx].x, y: packages[bestIdx].y });
    chosen.add(bestIdx);
  }
  
  let assignments = new Array(N).fill(-1);
  for (let iter = 0; iter < maxKMeansIterations; iter++) {
    let changed = false;
    const clusterSizes = new Array(K).fill(0);
    const sumX = new Array(K).fill(0);
    const sumY = new Array(K).fill(0);
    
    for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
      let bestCentroidIdx = -1;
      let minD = Infinity;
      for (let k = 0; k < K; k++) {
        const d = Math.pow(packages[i].x - centroids[k].x, 2) + Math.pow(packages[i].y - centroids[k].y, 2);
        if (d < minD) {
          minD = d;
          bestCentroidIdx = k;
        }
      }
      if (assignments[i] !== bestCentroidIdx) {
        assignments[i] = bestCentroidIdx;
        changed = true;
      }
      clusterSizes[bestCentroidIdx]++;
      sumX[bestCentroidIdx] += packages[i].x;
      sumY[bestCentroidIdx] += packages[i].y;
    }
    
    if (!changed) break;
    
    for (let k = 0; k < K; k++) {
      if (clusterSizes[k] > 0) {
        centroids[k].x = sumX[k] / clusterSizes[k];
        centroids[k].y = sumY[k] / clusterSizes[k];
      } else {
        let bestIdx = -1;
        let maxD = -1;
        for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
          const d = Math.pow(packages[i].x - centroids[assignments[i]].x, 2) + Math.pow(packages[i].y - centroids[assignments[i]].y, 2);
          if (d > maxD) {
            maxD = d;
            bestIdx = i;
          }
        }
        if (bestIdx !== -1) {
          centroids[k].x = packages[bestIdx].x;
          centroids[k].y = packages[bestIdx].y;
          assignments[bestIdx] = k;
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  const clusters = Array.from({ length: K }, () => []);
  for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
    clusters[assignments[i]].push(packages[i]);
  }
  
  const routes = [];
  for (let k = 0; k < K; k++) {
    routes.push(solveTSP(depot, clusters[k]));
  }
  return routes;
}

// 3. Clarke-Wright Savings VRP Solver
function runClarkeWright(depot, packages, K) {
  const N = packages.length;
  if (N === 0) return [];
  
  const routes = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
    routes.push([i]);
  }
  const routeOf = new Array(N);
  for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
    routeOf[i] = i;
  }
  
  const dists = Array.from({ length: N }, () => new Float64Array(N));
  for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
    for (let j = i + 1; j < N; j++) {
      const d = dist(packages[i], packages[j]);
      dists[i][j] = d;
      dists[j][i] = d;
    }
  }
  
  const savings = [];
  const pairAdded = new Uint8Array(N * N);
  
  for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
    const dDepotI = dist(depot, packages[i]);
    const candidates = [];
    for (let j = 0; j < N; j++) {
      if (i === j) continue;
      candidates.push({ j, d: dists[i][j] });
    }
    candidates.sort((a, b) => a.d - b.d);
    
    const limit = Math.min(candidates.length, 50);
    for (let k = 0; k < limit; k++) {
      const j = candidates[k].j;
      const minVal = Math.min(i, j);
      const maxVal = Math.max(i, j);
      const idx = minVal * N + maxVal;
      if (pairAdded[idx] === 1) continue;
      pairAdded[idx] = 1;
      
      const dDepotJ = dist(depot, packages[j]);
      const s = dDepotI + dDepotJ - dists[i][j];
      savings.push({ i, j, s });
    }
  }
  
  savings.sort((a, b) => b.s - a.s);
  
  let activeRouteCount = N;
  
  for (let idx = 0; idx < savings.length; idx++) {
    if (activeRouteCount <= K) break;
    
    const { i, j } = savings[idx];
    const r1 = routeOf[i];
    const r2 = routeOf[j];
    
    if (r1 === r2) continue;
    
    const R1 = routes[r1];
    const R2 = routes[r2];
    
    const first1 = R1[0];
    const last1 = R1[R1.length - 1];
    const first2 = R2[0];
    const last2 = R2[R2.length - 1];
    
    const iIsEnd = (i === first1 || i === last1);
    const jIsEnd = (j === first2 || j === last2);
    
    if (iIsEnd && jIsEnd) {
      let merged;
      if (i === last1 && j === first2) {
        merged = R1.concat(R2);
      } else if (i === first1 && j === first2) {
        merged = R1.slice().reverse().concat(R2);
      } else if (i === last1 && j === last2) {
        merged = R1.concat(R2.slice().reverse());
      } else {
        merged = R2.concat(R1);
      }
      
      routes[r1] = merged;
      routes[r2] = null;
      
      for (let m = 0; m < merged.length; m++) {
        routeOf[merged[m]] = r1;
      }
      
      activeRouteCount--;
    }
  }
  
  const activeRoutes = routes.filter(r => r !== null);
  const finalRoutes = activeRoutes.map(r => {
    const pkgs = r.map(idx => packages[idx]);
    return solveTSP(depot, pkgs, true);
  });
  
  while (finalRoutes.length < K) {
    finalRoutes.push([]);
  }
  
  return finalRoutes;
}

function computeTotalDistance(routes, depot, packagesMap) {
  let total = 0;
  for (const route of routes) {
    if (route.length === 0) continue;
    total += dist(depot, packagesMap.get(route[0]));
    for (let i = 0; i < route.length - 1; i++) {
      total += dist(packagesMap.get(route[i]), packagesMap.get(route[i + 1]));
    }
    total += dist(packagesMap.get(route[route.length - 1]), depot);
  }
  return total;
}

function main() {
  const input = fs.readFileSync(0, 'utf8');
  if (!input || input.trim() === '') {
    console.log(JSON.stringify({ routes: [] }));
    return;
  }
  
  const data = JSON.parse(input);
  const depot = { x: data.depot[0], y: data.depot[1] };
  const truckCount = data.truckCount;
  const packages = data.packages;
  
  if (!packages || packages.length === 0) {
    console.log(JSON.stringify({ routes: [] }));
    return;
  }
  
  const K = Math.min(truckCount, packages.length);
  const packagesMap = new Map(packages.map(p => [p.id, p]));
  
  let bestRoutes = null;
  let bestDist = Infinity;
  
  // Strategy 1: Angular Sweep
  const routesSweep = runSweep(depot, packages, K);
  const distSweep = computeTotalDistance(routesSweep, depot, packagesMap);
  if (distSweep < bestDist) {
    bestDist = distSweep;
    bestRoutes = routesSweep;
  }
  
  // Strategy 2: KMeans
  const routesKMeans = runKMeans(depot, packages, K);
  const distKMeans = computeTotalDistance(routesKMeans, depot, packagesMap);
  if (distKMeans < bestDist) {
    bestDist = distKMeans;
    bestRoutes = routesKMeans;
  }
  
  // Strategy 3: Clarke-Wright (for smaller scenarios to save time)
  if (packages.length <= 2000) {
    const routesCW = runClarkeWright(depot, packages, K);
    const distCW = computeTotalDistance(routesCW, depot, packagesMap);
    if (distCW < bestDist) {
      bestDist = distCW;
      bestRoutes = routesCW;
    }
  }
  
  // Filter out any empty routes
  const activeRoutes = bestRoutes.filter(r => r && r.length > 0);
  
  console.log(JSON.stringify({ routes: activeRoutes }));
}

main();

const fs = require('fs');

function solve() {
  const input = fs.readFileSync(0, 'utf8');
  if (!input.trim()) return;
  const data = JSON.parse(input);

  const width = data.width;
  const height = data.height;
  const grid = data.grid;
  const ignitions = data.ignitions;
  const towns = data.towns;
  const cutBudget = data.cutBudget;

  const numCells = width * height;

  // 1. Run BFS from ignitions to find reachable cells (baseline fire spread)
  const reachable = new Uint8Array(numCells);
  const q = [];
  for (const [x, y] of ignitions) {
    const id = y * width + x;
    if (grid[y][x] !== '~') {
      q.push(id);
      reachable[id] = 1;
    }
  }
  let qHead = 0;
  while (qHead < q.length) {
    const curr = q[qHead++];
    const cx = curr % width;
    const cy = Math.floor(curr / width);
    const neighbors = [
      [cx + 1, cy],
      [cx - 1, cy],
      [cx, cy + 1],
      [cx, cy - 1]
    ];
    for (const [nx, ny] of neighbors) {
      if (nx >= 0 && nx < width && ny >= 0 && ny < height) {
        if (grid[ny][nx] !== '~') {
          const nid = ny * width + nx;
          if (!reachable[nid]) {
            reachable[nid] = 1;
            q.push(nid);
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // Identify vulnerable towns (towns that would burn in the baseline)
  const vulnerableTowns = [];
  const townIdx = new Int32Array(numCells).fill(-1);
  for (let i = 0; i < towns.length; i++) {
    const t = towns[i];
    const id = t.y * width + t.x;
    townIdx[id] = i;
    if (reachable[id] === 1) {
      vulnerableTowns.push(t);
    }
  }

  // If no towns would burn anyway, or budget is 0, we need no cuts
  if (vulnerableTowns.length === 0 || cutBudget <= 0) {
    console.log(JSON.stringify({ firebreaks: [] }));
    return;
  }

  const isIgnition = new Uint8Array(numCells);
  for (const [x, y] of ignitions) {
    isIgnition[y * width + x] = 1;
  }

  // 2. Build the flow network
  const S = 2 * numCells;
  const T = 2 * numCells + 1;
  const numNodes = T + 1;
  const maxEdges = 16 * numCells;

  const head = new Int32Array(numNodes).fill(-1);
  const to = new Int32Array(maxEdges);
  const cap = new Int32Array(maxEdges);
  const flow = new Int32Array(maxEdges);
  const next = new Int32Array(maxEdges);
  let edgeCount = 0;

  function addEdge(u, v, c) {
    // Forward edge
    to[edgeCount] = v;
    cap[edgeCount] = c;
    flow[edgeCount] = 0;
    next[edgeCount] = head[u];
    head[u] = edgeCount++;

    // Reverse edge
    to[edgeCount] = u;
    cap[edgeCount] = 0;
    flow[edgeCount] = 0;
    next[edgeCount] = head[v];
    head[v] = edgeCount++;
  }

  // Add internal and neighbor transition edges for reachable cells
  for (let u = 0; u < numCells; u++) {
    if (reachable[u] === 1) {
      const u_in = 2 * u;
      const u_out = 2 * u + 1;
      let internalCap = 1;
      if (isIgnition[u] || townIdx[u] !== -1) {
        internalCap = 1000000; // Large capacity for source/sink nodes
      }
      addEdge(u_in, u_out, internalCap);

      const cx = u % width;
      const cy = Math.floor(u / width);
      const neighbors = [
        [cx + 1, cy],
        [cx - 1, cy],
        [cx, cy + 1],
        [cx, cy - 1]
      ];
      for (const [nx, ny] of neighbors) {
        if (nx >= 0 && nx < width && ny >= 0 && ny < height) {
          const v = ny * width + nx;
          if (grid[ny][nx] !== '~' && reachable[v] === 1) {
            const v_in = 2 * v;
            addEdge(u_out, v_in, 1000000);
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // Connect S to ignitions
  for (const [x, y] of ignitions) {
    const u = y * width + x;
    addEdge(S, 2 * u, 1000000);
  }

  // Connect towns to T (initially with capacity 0)
  const townEdgeIdx = new Int32Array(towns.length).fill(-1);
  for (let i = 0; i < towns.length; i++) {
    const t = towns[i];
    const u = t.y * width + t.x;
    if (reachable[u] === 1) {
      addEdge(2 * u + 1, T, 0);
      townEdgeIdx[i] = edgeCount - 2;
    }
  }

  // 3. Optimized Dinic's Algorithm
  const level = new Int32Array(numNodes).fill(-1);
  const queue = new Int32Array(numNodes);
  const ptr = new Int32Array(numNodes);
  const ptrToken = new Int32Array(numNodes);
  let queueLength = 0;
  let currentPtrToken = 0;

  function bfs(src, dest) {
    for (let i = 0; i < queueLength; i++) {
      level[queue[i]] = -1;
    }
    queueLength = 0;

    level[src] = 0;
    queue[queueLength++] = src;
    let headQ = 0;
    while (headQ < queueLength) {
      const u = queue[headQ++];
      for (let e = head[u]; e !== -1; e = next[e]) {
        const v = to[e];
        if (cap[e] - flow[e] > 0 && level[v] === -1) {
          level[v] = level[u] + 1;
          queue[queueLength++] = v;
        }
      }
    }
    return level[dest] !== -1;
  }

  function dfs(u, dest, pushed) {
    if (pushed === 0) return 0;
    if (u === dest) return pushed;

    if (ptrToken[u] !== currentPtrToken) {
      ptrToken[u] = currentPtrToken;
      ptr[u] = head[u];
    }

    for (let cid = ptr[u]; cid !== -1; cid = next[cid]) {
      ptr[u] = cid;
      const v = to[cid];
      const tr = cap[cid] - flow[cid];
      if (level[u] + 1 !== level[v] || tr === 0) continue;
      const push = dfs(v, dest, Math.min(pushed, tr));
      if (push === 0) continue;
      flow[cid] += push;
      flow[cid ^ 1] -= push;
      return push;
    }
    return 0;
  }

  function cleanupBfs() {
    for (let i = 0; i < queueLength; i++) {
      level[queue[i]] = -1;
    }
    queueLength = 0;
  }

  function dinic(src, dest, limit) {
    let totalFlow = 0;
    queueLength = 0;
    while (bfs(src, dest)) {
      currentPtrToken++;
      while (true) {
        const pushed = dfs(src, dest, limit - totalFlow);
        if (pushed === 0) break;
        totalFlow += pushed;
        if (totalFlow >= limit) {
          cleanupBfs();
          return totalFlow;
        }
      }
    }
    cleanupBfs();
    return totalFlow;
  }

  function resetFlow() {
    flow.fill(0);
  }

  // 4. Calculate individual min-cut cost for each vulnerable town
  const individualCosts = new Int32Array(towns.length);
  for (let i = 0; i < towns.length; i++) {
    const eIdx = townEdgeIdx[i];
    if (eIdx === -1) {
      individualCosts[i] = 0;
      continue;
    }

    resetFlow();
    for (let j = 0; j < towns.length; j++) {
      const idx = townEdgeIdx[j];
      if (idx !== -1) {
        cap[idx] = (j === i) ? 1000000 : 0;
      }
    }

    individualCosts[i] = dinic(S, T, cutBudget + 1);
  }

  // Filter out vulnerable towns that cannot be saved individually within budget
  const candidateTowns = [];
  for (const t of vulnerableTowns) {
    const cost = individualCosts[t.id];
    if (cost <= cutBudget) {
      candidateTowns.push({
        id: t.id,
        x: t.x,
        y: t.y,
        value: t.value,
        individualCost: cost
      });
    }
  }

  if (candidateTowns.length === 0) {
    console.log(JSON.stringify({ firebreaks: [] }));
    return;
  }

  // 5. Function to run the greedy selection for a given order of towns
  const savedFlow = new Int32Array(maxEdges);

  function getMinCutCuts() {
    const visited = new Uint8Array(numNodes);
    const qC = new Int32Array(numNodes);
    let qHead = 0;
    let qTail = 0;

    qC[qTail++] = S;
    visited[S] = 1;

    while (qHead < qTail) {
      const u = qC[qHead++];
      for (let e = head[u]; e !== -1; e = next[e]) {
        const v = to[e];
        if (cap[e] - flow[e] > 0 && !visited[v]) {
          visited[v] = 1;
          qC[qTail++] = v;
        }
      }
    }

    const cuts = [];
    for (let u = 0; u < numCells; u++) {
      if (reachable[u] === 1 && !isIgnition[u] && townIdx[u] === -1) {
        const u_in = 2 * u;
        const u_out = 2 * u + 1;
        if (visited[u_in] && !visited[u_out]) {
          const cx = u % width;
          const cy = Math.floor(u / width);
          cuts.push([cx, cy]);
        }
      }
    }
    return cuts;
  }

  function runGreedyForOrder(sortedTowns) {
    resetFlow();
    for (let i = 0; i < towns.length; i++) {
      const eIdx = townEdgeIdx[i];
      if (eIdx !== -1) {
        cap[eIdx] = 0;
      }
    }

    let currentValue = 0;
    let currentFlow = 0;

    for (const t of sortedTowns) {
      const eIdx = townEdgeIdx[t.id];
      if (eIdx === -1) continue;

      savedFlow.set(flow);
      cap[eIdx] = 1000000;

      const additionalFlow = dinic(S, T, cutBudget + 1 - currentFlow);
      const newFlow = currentFlow + additionalFlow;

      if (newFlow <= cutBudget) {
        currentFlow = newFlow;
        currentValue += t.value;
      } else {
        flow.set(savedFlow);
        cap[eIdx] = 0;
      }
    }

    const cuts = getMinCutCuts();
    return { value: currentValue, cuts: cuts };
  }

  // 6. Run trials to find the best selection of towns to save
  const startTime = Date.now();
  const timeLimit = 400; // Limit search to 400ms to stay safe

  let bestValue = -1;
  let bestCuts = [];

  let trial = 0;
  while (true) {
    // Deterministic strategies for the first few trials, then randomized
    let sorted = [...candidateTowns];
    if (trial === 0) {
      // Sort by value/cost descending
      sorted.sort((a, b) => b.value / b.individualCost - a.value / a.individualCost);
    } else if (trial === 1) {
      // Sort by value descending
      sorted.sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value);
    } else if (trial === 2) {
      // Sort by value^2 / cost descending
      sorted.sort((a, b) => (b.value * b.value) / b.individualCost - (a.value * a.value) / a.individualCost);
    } else if (trial === 3) {
      // Sort by cost ascending
      sorted.sort((a, b) => a.individualCost - b.individualCost);
    } else {
      // Randomized priority search
      if (Date.now() - startTime >= timeLimit) {
        break;
      }
      sorted.sort((a, b) => {
        const noiseA = 1.0 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.4;
        const noiseB = 1.0 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.4;
        const scoreA = (a.value / a.individualCost) * noiseA;
        const scoreB = (b.value / b.individualCost) * noiseB;
        return scoreB - scoreA;
      });
    }

    const result = runGreedyForOrder(sorted);
    if (result.value > bestValue) {
      bestValue = result.value;
      bestCuts = result.cuts;
    }

    trial++;
    if (trial >= 100) {
      // If we did 100 trials, we are already very likely to have found the optimal or near-optimal
      break;
    }
  }

  // Output the firebreaks
  console.log(JSON.stringify({ firebreaks: bestCuts }));
}

solve();

const fs = require('fs');

function main() {
  const input = fs.readFileSync(0, 'utf8');
  const data = JSON.parse(input);

  const grid = data.grid;
  const H = grid.length;
  const W = grid[0].length;

  const robots = data.robots;
  const jobs = data.jobs;

  // Environment variable limit or default
  const limitEnv = process.env.WAREHOUSE_EXACT_JOB_LIMIT;
  const WAREHOUSE_EXACT_JOB_LIMIT = limitEnv ? parseInt(limitEnv, 10) : 150;
  const largeCase = jobs.length > WAREHOUSE_EXACT_JOB_LIMIT;

  // Create jobs map
  const jobsMap = {};
  for (const job of jobs) {
    jobsMap[job.id] = job;
  }

  // remaining holds job IDs, sorted ascending
  const remaining = jobs.map(j => j.id).sort((a, b) => {
    const na = Number(a);
    const nb = Number(b);
    return na - nb;
  });

  // Initialize assignments
  const assignments = robots.map(() => []);

  // Current positions of robots
  const current = robots.map(r => ({ x: r.x, y: r.y }));

  // Cache for grid distances
  const cache = new Map();

  function getDistance(pos, target) {
    if (largeCase) {
      return Math.abs(pos.x - target.x) + Math.abs(pos.y - target.y);
    } else {
      const startKey = pos.y * W + pos.x;
      let dists = cache.get(startKey);
      if (!dists) {
        dists = new Int32Array(W * H);
        dists.fill(1e9);
        dists[startKey] = 0;

        const q = new Int32Array(W * H);
        let head = 0;
        let tail = 0;
        q[tail++] = startKey;

        while (head < tail) {
          const key = q[head++];
          const x = key % W;
          const y = Math.floor(key / W);
          const nd = dists[key] + 1;

          // Neighbors: (x + 1, y), (x - 1, y), (x, y + 1), (x, y - 1)
          if (x + 1 < W && grid[y][x + 1] !== '#') {
            const nkey = key + 1;
            if (dists[nkey] === 1e9) {
              dists[nkey] = nd;
              q[tail++] = nkey;
            }
          }
          if (x - 1 >= 0 && grid[y][x - 1] !== '#') {
            const nkey = key - 1;
            if (dists[nkey] === 1e9) {
              dists[nkey] = nd;
              q[tail++] = nkey;
            }
          }
          if (y + 1 < H && grid[y + 1][x] !== '#') {
            const nkey = key + W;
            if (dists[nkey] === 1e9) {
              dists[nkey] = nd;
              q[tail++] = nkey;
            }
          }
          if (y - 1 >= 0 && grid[y - 1][x] !== '#') {
            const nkey = key - W;
            if (dists[nkey] === 1e9) {
              dists[nkey] = nd;
              q[tail++] = nkey;
            }
          }
        }
        cache.set(startKey, dists);
      }
      return dists[target.y * W + target.x];
    }
  }

  while (remaining.length > 0) {
    let best = null;
    for (let ri = 0; ri < current.length; ri++) {
      const pos = current[ri];
      for (let i = 0; i < remaining.length; i++) {
        const jid = remaining[i];
        const d = getDistance(pos, jobsMap[jid]);
        if (best === null || d < best.d) {
          best = { d, ri, jid, index: i };
        }
      }
    }
    assignments[best.ri].push(best.jid);
    current[best.ri] = jobsMap[best.jid];
    remaining.splice(best.index, 1);
  }

  console.log(JSON.stringify({ assignments }));
}

main();

const fs = require('fs');

function main() {
  const input = fs.readFileSync(0, 'utf8');
  if (!input) return;
  const data = JSON.parse(input);

  const probability = data.probability;
  const drones = data.drones;
  const maxStepsPerDrone = data.maxStepsPerDrone;

  const height = probability.length;
  const width = probability[0].length;

  const startTime = Date.now();

  // Multi-source BFS to precompute distance to nearest reward
  const minDistToReward = Array.from({length: height}, () => new Int32Array(width).fill(-1));
  const queue = [];
  let head = 0;

  for (let r = 0; r < height; r++) {
    for (let c = 0; c < width; c++) {
      if (probability[r][c] > 0) {
        minDistToReward[r][c] = 0;
        queue.push(c, r);
      }
    }
  }

  const dirs = [[0, 1], [0, -1], [1, 0], [-1, 0]];

  while (head < queue.length) {
    const cx = queue[head++];
    const cy = queue[head++];
    const cd = minDistToReward[cy][cx];

    for (const [dx, dy] of dirs) {
      const nx = cx + dx;
      const ny = cy + dy;
      if (nx >= 0 && nx < width && ny >= 0 && ny < height) {
        if (probability[ny][nx] !== -1 && minDistToReward[ny][nx] === -1) {
          minDistToReward[ny][nx] = cd + 1;
          queue.push(nx, ny);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  const globalVisited = new Int32Array(width * height);
  const tempVisited = new Uint8Array(width * height);
  const beamVisited = new Uint8Array(width * height);
  const currentPathVisited = new Uint8Array(width * height);

  let B = 10;
  let maxDepth = 10;
  const totalSteps = drones.length * maxStepsPerDrone;
  if (totalSteps > 1000) {
    B = 5;
    maxDepth = 6;
  } else if (totalSteps > 500) {
    B = 8;
    maxDepth = 8;
  } else {
    B = 15;
    maxDepth = 12;
  }

  const qSize = (2 * (maxDepth + 1) * (maxDepth + 1) + 10) * 3;
  const q = new Int32Array(qSize);

  let totalCoverageScore = 0;

  function addPathToGlobal(path) {
    for (const [x, y] of path) {
      const key = y * width + x;
      if (globalVisited[key] === 0 && probability[y][x] > 0) {
        totalCoverageScore += probability[y][x];
      }
      globalVisited[key]++;
    }
  }

  function removePathFromGlobal(path) {
    for (const [x, y] of path) {
      const key = y * width + x;
      globalVisited[key]--;
      if (globalVisited[key] === 0 && probability[y][x] > 0) {
        totalCoverageScore -= probability[y][x];
      }
    }
  }

  function getHeuristic(x, y, pathKeys, maxDepth) {
    let score = 0;
    let foundReward = false;

    for (let i = 0; i < pathKeys.length; i++) {
      currentPathVisited[pathKeys[i]] = 1;
    }

    let qHead = 0;
    let qTail = 0;

    const startKey = y * width + x;
    tempVisited[startKey] = 1;
    const localVisited = [startKey];

    q[qTail++] = x;
    q[qTail++] = y;
    q[qTail++] = 0;

    while (qHead < qTail) {
      const cx = q[qHead++];
      const cy = q[qHead++];
      const cd = q[qHead++];

      const cellKey = cy * width + cx;
      if (probability[cy][cx] > 0 && globalVisited[cellKey] === 0 && currentPathVisited[cellKey] === 0) {
        score += probability[cy][cx] / (cd + 1);
        foundReward = true;
      }

      if (cd < maxDepth) {
        for (const [dx, dy] of dirs) {
          const nx = cx + dx;
          const ny = cy + dy;
          if (nx >= 0 && nx < width && ny >= 0 && ny < height) {
            if (probability[ny][nx] !== -1) {
              const nkey = ny * width + nx;
              if (tempVisited[nkey] === 0) {
                tempVisited[nkey] = 1;
                localVisited.push(nkey);
                q[qTail++] = nx;
                q[qTail++] = ny;
                q[qTail++] = cd + 1;
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }

    for (const k of localVisited) {
      tempVisited[k] = 0;
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < pathKeys.length; i++) {
      currentPathVisited[pathKeys[i]] = 0;
    }

    if (foundReward) {
      return score;
    } else {
      const d = minDistToReward[y][x];
      if (d === -1) {
        return -1000000;
      }
      return -d * 0.01;
    }
  }

  const dirsWithStay = [[0, 0], [0, 1], [0, -1], [1, 0], [-1, 0]];

  function planDronePath(droneIndex) {
    const drone = drones[droneIndex];
    const startX = drone.x;
    const startY = drone.y;

    const startKey = startY * width + startX;
    const startReward = (globalVisited[startKey] === 0 && probability[startY][startX] > 0) ? probability[startY][startX] : 0;

    let beam = [{
      x: startX,
      y: startY,
      path: [[startX, startY]],
      pathKeys: [startKey],
      score: startReward,
      hScore: startReward + getHeuristic(startX, startY, [startKey], maxDepth)
    }];

    for (let step = 1; step <= maxStepsPerDrone; step++) {
      const candidates = [];

      for (const state of beam) {
        for (let i = 0; i < state.pathKeys.length; i++) {
          beamVisited[state.pathKeys[i]] = 1;
        }

        for (const [dx, dy] of dirsWithStay) {
          const nx = state.x + dx;
          const ny = state.y + dy;

          if (nx >= 0 && nx < width && ny >= 0 && ny < height) {
            if (probability[ny][nx] !== -1) {
              const nkey = ny * width + nx;
              const isNewVisit = (globalVisited[nkey] === 0 && beamVisited[nkey] === 0 && probability[ny][nx] > 0);
              const newScore = state.score + (isNewVisit ? probability[ny][nx] : 0);

              const newPathKeys = state.pathKeys.concat([nkey]);
              const newPath = state.path.concat([[nx, ny]]);

              const h = getHeuristic(nx, ny, newPathKeys, maxDepth);
              const newHScore = newScore + h;

              candidates.push({
                x: nx,
                y: ny,
                path: newPath,
                pathKeys: newPathKeys,
                score: newScore,
                hScore: newHScore
              });
            }
          }
        }

        for (let i = 0; i < state.pathKeys.length; i++) {
          beamVisited[state.pathKeys[i]] = 0;
        }
      }

      if (candidates.length === 0) {
        break;
      }

      const seen = new Map();
      const nextCandidates = [];
      for (const cand of candidates) {
        const key = cand.y * width + cand.x;
        if (!seen.has(key)) {
          seen.set(key, []);
        }
        seen.get(key).push(cand);
      }

      for (const [key, list] of seen) {
        list.sort((a, b) => b.hScore - a.hScore);
        nextCandidates.push(...list.slice(0, 2));
      }

      nextCandidates.sort((a, b) => b.hScore - a.hScore);
      beam = nextCandidates.slice(0, B);
    }

    return beam[0].path;
  }

  const paths = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < drones.length; i++) {
    paths.push([]);
  }

  for (let i = 0; i < drones.length; i++) {
    const path = planDronePath(i);
    paths[i] = path;
    addPathToGlobal(path);
  }

  while (Date.now() - startTime < 1000) {
    let improved = false;
    for (let i = 0; i < drones.length; i++) {
      if (Date.now() - startTime >= 1200) break;

      const oldPath = paths[i];
      const oldScore = totalCoverageScore;

      removePathFromGlobal(oldPath);
      const newPath = planDronePath(i);
      addPathToGlobal(newPath);
      paths[i] = newPath;

      if (totalCoverageScore > oldScore) {
        improved = true;
      } else {
        removePathFromGlobal(newPath);
        addPathToGlobal(oldPath);
        paths[i] = oldPath;
      }
    }
    if (!improved) {
      break;
    }
  }

  console.log(JSON.stringify({ paths }));
}

main();

const fs = require('fs');

function solve() {
    let input;
    try {
        input = fs.readFileSync(0, 'utf8');
    } catch (e) {
        return;
    }
    if (!input || input.trim() === "") return;
    const data = JSON.parse(input);

    const machineCount = data.machineCount || 1;
    const tasks = data.tasks || [];
    const n = tasks.length;

    if (n === 0) {
        console.log(JSON.stringify({ schedule: [] }));
        return;
    }

    const idToIndex = new Map();
    const taskIds = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const id = tasks[i].id;
        idToIndex.set(id, i);
        taskIds.push(id);
    }

    const duration = new Float64Array(n);
    const deadline = new Float64Array(n);
    const weight = new Float64Array(n);
    const adj = Array.from({ length: n }, () => []);
    const parents = Array.from({ length: n }, () => []);
    const inDegree = new Int32Array(n);

    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const task = tasks[i];
        const u = idToIndex.get(task.id);
        duration[u] = task.duration || 0;
        deadline[u] = task.deadline !== undefined ? task.deadline : 1e9;
        weight[u] = task.weight !== undefined ? task.weight : 1;
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const task = tasks[i];
        const u = idToIndex.get(task.id);
        const deps = task.deps || [];
        for (let j = 0; j < deps.length; j++) {
            const p = idToIndex.get(deps[j]);
            if (p !== undefined) {
                adj[p].push(u);
                parents[u].push(p);
                inDegree[u]++;
            }
        }
    }

    class MinHeap {
        constructor(compareFn) {
            this.data = [];
            this.compare = compareFn;
        }
        push(val) {
            this.data.push(val);
            this.up(this.data.length - 1);
        }
        pop() {
            if (this.data.length === 0) return null;
            const top = this.data[0];
            const bottom = this.data.pop();
            if (this.data.length > 0) {
                this.data[0] = bottom;
                this.down(0);
            }
            return top;
        }
        size() {
            return this.data.length;
        }
        up(i) {
            while (i > 0) {
                const p = (i - 1) >> 1;
                if (this.compare(this.data[i], this.data[p]) < 0) {
                    const tmp = this.data[i];
                    this.data[i] = this.data[p];
                    this.data[p] = tmp;
                    i = p;
                } else {
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        down(i) {
            const len = this.data.length;
            while ((i << 1) + 1 < len) {
                let child = (i << 1) + 1;
                if (child + 1 < len && this.compare(this.data[child + 1], this.data[child]) < 0) {
                    child++;
                }
                if (this.compare(this.data[child], this.data[i]) < 0) {
                    const tmp = this.data[i];
                    this.data[i] = this.data[child];
                    this.data[child] = tmp;
                    i = child;
                } else {
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    function getPriorityOrder(priorityVal) {
        const heap = new MinHeap((a, b) => {
            if (priorityVal[a] !== priorityVal[b]) {
                return priorityVal[a] - priorityVal[b];
            }
            return a - b;
        });

        const tempInDegree = inDegree.slice();
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (tempInDegree[i] === 0) {
                heap.push(i);
            }
        }

        const order = [];
        while (heap.size() > 0) {
            const u = heap.pop();
            order.push(u);
            const children = adj[u];
            for (let i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                const v = children[i];
                tempInDegree[v]--;
                if (tempInDegree[v] === 0) {
                    heap.push(v);
                }
            }
        }
        
        if (order.length < n) {
            const visited = new Uint8Array(n);
            for (let i = 0; i < order.length; i++) {
                visited[order[i]] = 1;
            }
            for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                if (!visited[i]) {
                    order.push(i);
                }
            }
        }

        return order;
    }

    const compTime = new Float64Array(n);
    const startTime = new Float64Array(n);
    const assignedMachine = new Int32Array(n);
    const est = new Float64Array(n);
    const machineFreeTime = new Float64Array(machineCount);
    const machineId = new Int32Array(machineCount);

    function simulateBinaryReuse(order) {
        for (let m = 0; m < machineCount; m++) {
            machineFreeTime[m] = 0;
            machineId[m] = m;
        }
        est.fill(0);

        let makespan = 0;
        let totalWeightedLateness = 0;

        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            const u = order[i];
            const Ei = est[u];

            let chosenIdx = 0;
            if (machineFreeTime[0] < Ei) {
                let low = 0;
                let high = machineCount - 1;
                let ans = 0;
                while (low <= high) {
                    const mid = (low + high) >> 1;
                    if (machineFreeTime[mid] <= Ei) {
                        ans = mid;
                        low = mid + 1;
                    } else {
                        high = mid - 1;
                    }
                }
                chosenIdx = ans;
            }

            const mFreeTime = machineFreeTime[chosenIdx];
            const mId = machineId[chosenIdx];

            const S_u = Math.max(Ei, mFreeTime);
            const C_u = S_u + duration[u];

            startTime[u] = S_u;
            compTime[u] = C_u;
            assignedMachine[u] = mId;

            const newFreeTime = C_u;

            let low = 0;
            let high = machineCount - 1;
            let insertIdx = machineCount;
            while (low <= high) {
                const mid = (low + high) >> 1;
                if (machineFreeTime[mid] >= newFreeTime) {
                    insertIdx = mid;
                    high = mid - 1;
                } else {
                    low = mid + 1;
                }
            }

            if (insertIdx > chosenIdx) {
                const targetInsert = insertIdx - 1;
                for (let k = chosenIdx; k < targetInsert; k++) {
                    machineFreeTime[k] = machineFreeTime[k + 1];
                    machineId[k] = machineId[k + 1];
                }
                machineFreeTime[targetInsert] = newFreeTime;
                machineId[targetInsert] = mId;
            } else {
                for (let k = chosenIdx; k > insertIdx; k--) {
                    machineFreeTime[k] = machineFreeTime[k - 1];
                    machineId[k] = machineId[k - 1];
                }
                machineFreeTime[insertIdx] = newFreeTime;
                machineId[insertIdx] = mId;
            }

            if (C_u > makespan) {
                makespan = C_u;
            }

            const lateness = Math.max(0, C_u - deadline[u]);
            totalWeightedLateness += weight[u] * lateness;

            const children = adj[u];
            for (let j = 0; j < children.length; j++) {
                const v = children[j];
                if (C_u > est[v]) {
                    est[v] = C_u;
                }
            }
        }

        return makespan + totalWeightedLateness;
    }

    const baseOrder = getPriorityOrder(new Float64Array(n));
    
    const tempEst = new Float64Array(n);
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const u = baseOrder[i];
        const children = adj[u];
        for (let j = 0; j < children.length; j++) {
            const v = children[j];
            tempEst[v] = Math.max(tempEst[v], tempEst[u] + duration[u]);
        }
    }

    const lct = new Float64Array(n);
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        lct[i] = deadline[i];
    }
    for (let i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        const u = baseOrder[i];
        const pList = parents[u];
        for (let j = 0; j < pList.length; j++) {
            const p = pList[j];
            lct[p] = Math.min(lct[p], lct[u] - duration[u]);
        }
    }

    const lst = new Float64Array(n);
    const slack = new Float64Array(n);
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        lst[i] = lct[i] - duration[i];
        slack[i] = lst[i] - tempEst[i];
    }

    const wspt = new Float64Array(n);
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        wspt[i] = -weight[i] / (duration[i] || 1);
    }

    const initialCandidates = [];
    initialCandidates.push(deadline);
    initialCandidates.push(lst);
    initialCandidates.push(slack);
    initialCandidates.push(wspt);

    const C_values = [1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000, 100000, 1000000];
    for (let i = 0; i < C_values.length; i++) {
        const C = C_values[i];
        const combined = new Float64Array(n);
        for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) {
            combined[j] = lst[j] + C * wspt[j];
        }
        initialCandidates.push(combined);
    }

    let bestCost = Infinity;
    let bestOrder = null;

    for (let i = 0; i < initialCandidates.length; i++) {
        const ord = getPriorityOrder(initialCandidates[i]);
        const cost = simulateBinaryReuse(ord);
        if (cost < bestCost) {
            bestCost = cost;
            bestOrder = ord;
        }
    }

    const currentOrder = bestOrder.slice();
    const pos = new Int32Array(n);
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        pos[currentOrder[i]] = i;
    }

    let currentCost = bestCost;
    let bestGlobalCost = bestCost;
    const bestGlobalOrder = bestOrder.slice();

    let timeLimit = 1000;
    if (n <= 100) {
        timeLimit = 200;
    } else if (n > 1000) {
        timeLimit = 2000;
    }

    const saStartTime = Date.now();
    const T0 = Math.max(1.0, bestCost * 0.0005);
    const Tmin = 0.01;

    function shiftMove(u, fromIdx, toIdx) {
        if (fromIdx < toIdx) {
            for (let k = fromIdx; k < toIdx; k++) {
                currentOrder[k] = currentOrder[k + 1];
                pos[currentOrder[k]] = k;
            }
        } else {
            for (let k = fromIdx; k > toIdx; k--) {
                currentOrder[k] = currentOrder[k - 1];
                pos[currentOrder[k]] = k;
            }
        }
        currentOrder[toIdx] = u;
        pos[u] = toIdx;
    }

    while (true) {
        const elapsed = Date.now() - saStartTime;
        if (elapsed >= timeLimit) break;

        const progress = elapsed / timeLimit;
        const T = T0 * Math.pow(Tmin / T0, progress);

        const randMove = Math.random();
        if (randMove < 0.8) {
            let u;
            let targetLeft = false;
            
            const lateTasks = [];
            for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                if (compTime[i] > deadline[i]) {
                    lateTasks.push(i);
                }
            }

            if (lateTasks.length > 0 && Math.random() < 0.7) {
                u = lateTasks[Math.floor(Math.random() * lateTasks.length)];
                targetLeft = true;
            } else {
                u = Math.floor(Math.random() * n);
            }

            const fromIdx = pos[u];

            let maxParentIdx = -1;
            const pList = parents[u];
            for (let j = 0; j < pList.length; j++) {
                const pIdx = pos[pList[j]];
                if (pIdx > maxParentIdx) maxParentIdx = pIdx;
            }
            let minChildIdx = n;
            const cList = adj[u];
            for (let j = 0; j < cList.length; j++) {
                const cIdx = pos[cList[j]];
                if (cIdx < minChildIdx) minChildIdx = cIdx;
            }

            let toIdx = fromIdx;
            if (targetLeft) {
                const leftBound = maxParentIdx + 1;
                const rightBound = fromIdx - 1;
                if (leftBound <= rightBound) {
                    toIdx = Math.floor(Math.random() * (rightBound - leftBound + 1)) + leftBound;
                } else {
                    if (maxParentIdx + 1 < minChildIdx - 1) {
                        while (toIdx === fromIdx) {
                            toIdx = Math.floor(Math.random() * (minChildIdx - maxParentIdx - 1)) + maxParentIdx + 1;
                        }
                    }
                }
            } else {
                if (maxParentIdx + 1 < minChildIdx - 1) {
                    while (toIdx === fromIdx) {
                        toIdx = Math.floor(Math.random() * (minChildIdx - maxParentIdx - 1)) + maxParentIdx + 1;
                    }
                }
            }

            if (toIdx === fromIdx) continue;

            shiftMove(u, fromIdx, toIdx);

            const nextCost = simulateBinaryReuse(currentOrder);
            const delta = nextCost - currentCost;

            let accept = false;
            if (delta <= 0) {
                accept = true;
            } else {
                if (Math.random() < Math.exp(-delta / T)) {
                    accept = true;
                }
            }

            if (accept) {
                currentCost = nextCost;
                if (currentCost < bestGlobalCost) {
                    bestGlobalCost = currentCost;
                    for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) bestGlobalOrder[j] = currentOrder[j];
                }
            } else {
                shiftMove(u, toIdx, fromIdx);
                simulateBinaryReuse(currentOrder);
            }
        } else {
            if (n < 2) continue;
            const i = Math.floor(Math.random() * (n - 1));
            const u = currentOrder[i];
            const v = currentOrder[i + 1];

            let isParent = false;
            const uAdj = adj[u];
            for (let j = 0; j < uAdj.length; j++) {
                if (uAdj[j] === v) {
                    isParent = true;
                    break;
                }
            }

            if (!isParent) {
                currentOrder[i] = v;
                currentOrder[i + 1] = u;
                pos[v] = i;
                pos[u] = i + 1;

                const nextCost = simulateBinaryReuse(currentOrder);
                const delta = nextCost - currentCost;

                let accept = false;
                if (delta <= 0) {
                    accept = true;
                } else {
                    if (Math.random() < Math.exp(-delta / T)) {
                        accept = true;
                    }
                }

                if (accept) {
                    currentCost = nextCost;
                    if (currentCost < bestGlobalCost) {
                        bestGlobalCost = currentCost;
                        for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) bestGlobalOrder[j] = currentOrder[j];
                    }
                } else {
                    currentOrder[i] = u;
                    currentOrder[i + 1] = v;
                    pos[u] = i;
                    pos[v] = i + 1;
                    simulateBinaryReuse(currentOrder);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    simulateBinaryReuse(bestGlobalOrder);

    const output = {
        schedule: []
    };
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const taskId = taskIds[i];
        output.schedule.push({
            id: taskId,
            start: startTime[i],
            machine: assignedMachine[i]
        });
    }

    console.log(JSON.stringify(output));
}

solve();

declare const require: any;
const fs = require('fs');

interface Package {
  id: number;
  x: number;
  y: number;
}

interface InputData {
  depot: [number, number];
  truckCount: number;
  packages: Package[];
}

function solve() {
  const input: string = fs.readFileSync(0, 'utf8');
  const data: InputData = JSON.parse(input);
  const depot = data.depot;
  const truckCount = data.truckCount;
  const packages = data.packages;
  const N = packages.length;

  if (N === 0) {
    console.log(JSON.stringify({ routes: [] }));
    return;
  }

  // 1. Sort packages by polar angle relative to the depot
  const packagesWithAngle = packages.map(p => {
    const dx = p.x - depot[0];
    const dy = p.y - depot[1];
    return {
      id: p.id,
      x: p.x,
      y: p.y,
      angle: Math.atan2(dy, dx)
    };
  });
  packagesWithAngle.sort((a, b) => a.angle - b.angle);

  // 2. Partition packages into K routes
  const K = Math.min(truckCount, N);
  const routes: number[][] = [];

  let maxIter = 5;
  if (N > 100000) {
    maxIter = 1;
  } else if (N > 20000) {
    maxIter = 2;
  }

  for (let t = 0; t < K; t++) {
    const startIdx = Math.floor((N * t) / K);
    const endIdx = Math.floor((N * (t + 1)) / K);
    const chunk = packagesWithAngle.slice(startIdx, endIdx);
    if (chunk.length === 0) continue;

    const route = solveTSPForChunk(chunk, depot, maxIter);
    routes.push(route);
  }

  console.log(JSON.stringify({ routes }));
}

function solveTSPForChunk(
  chunk: { id: number; x: number; y: number }[],
  depot: [number, number],
  maxIter: number
): number[] {
  const M = chunk.length;
  if (M === 1) {
    return [chunk[0].id];
  }

  if (M > 1000) {
    // Return the angular order directly for very large route sizes to prevent timeout
    return chunk.map(p => p.id);
  }

  // Flat arrays for fast V8 access
  const xs = new Float64Array(M);
  const ys = new Float64Array(M);
  for (let i = 0; i < M; i++) {
    xs[i] = chunk[i].x;
    ys[i] = chunk[i].y;
  }

  // Nearest Neighbor heuristic
  const visited = new Uint8Array(M);
  const routeIdx = new Int32Array(M);
  let curX = depot[0];
  let curY = depot[1];

  for (let step = 0; step < M; step++) {
    let bestIdx = -1;
    let bestDistSq = Infinity;
    for (let i = 0; i < M; i++) {
      if (visited[i] === 0) {
        const dx = xs[i] - curX;
        const dy = ys[i] - curY;
        const distSq = dx * dx + dy * dy;
        if (distSq < bestDistSq) {
          bestDistSq = distSq;
          bestIdx = i;
        }
      }
    }
    visited[bestIdx] = 1;
    routeIdx[step] = bestIdx;
    curX = xs[bestIdx];
    curY = ys[bestIdx];
  }

  // 2-opt local search
  const tour = new Int32Array(M + 2);
  tour[0] = -1; // -1 represents depot
  for (let i = 0; i < M; i++) {
    tour[i + 1] = routeIdx[i];
  }
  tour[M + 1] = -1;

  const txs = new Float64Array(M + 2);
  const tys = new Float64Array(M + 2);
  txs[0] = depot[0]; tys[0] = depot[1];
  txs[M + 1] = depot[0]; tys[M + 1] = depot[1];
  for (let i = 0; i < M; i++) {
    txs[i + 1] = xs[routeIdx[i]];
    tys[i + 1] = ys[routeIdx[i]];
  }

  let improved = true;
  let iter = 0;
  while (improved && iter < maxIter) {
    improved = false;
    for (let i = 0; i < M; i++) {
      const x_i = txs[i];
      const y_i = tys[i];
      const x_i1 = txs[i + 1];
      const y_i1 = tys[i + 1];
      const dx_i_i1 = x_i - x_i1;
      const dy_i_i1 = y_i - y_i1;
      const curDist1 = Math.sqrt(dx_i_i1 * dx_i_i1 + dy_i_i1 * dy_i_i1);

      for (let j = i + 2; j <= M; j++) {
        const x_j = txs[j];
        const y_j = tys[j];
        const x_j1 = txs[j + 1];
        const y_j1 = tys[j + 1];

        const dx_j_j1 = x_j - x_j1;
        const dy_j_j1 = y_j - y_j1;
        const curDist2 = Math.sqrt(dx_j_j1 * dx_j_j1 + dy_j_j1 * dy_j_j1);

        const dx_i_j = x_i - x_j;
        const dy_i_j = y_i - y_j;
        const newDist1 = Math.sqrt(dx_i_j * dx_i_j + dy_i_j * dy_i_j);

        const dx_i1_j1 = x_i1 - x_j1;
        const dy_i1_j1 = y_i1 - y_j1;
        const newDist2 = Math.sqrt(dx_i1_j1 * dx_i1_j1 + dy_i1_j1 * dy_i1_j1);

        const curDist = curDist1 + curDist2;
        const newDist = newDist1 + newDist2;

        if (newDist < curDist - 1e-9) {
          // Reverse segment from i+1 to j
          let l = i + 1;
          let r = j;
          while (l < r) {
            const tempIdx = tour[l]; tour[l] = tour[r]; tour[r] = tempIdx;
            const tempX = txs[l]; txs[l] = txs[r]; txs[r] = tempX;
            const tempY = tys[l]; tys[l] = tys[r]; tys[r] = tempY;
            l++;
            r--;
          }
          improved = true;
          break;
        }
      }
      if (improved) {
        break;
      }
    }
    iter++;
  }

  const finalRoute: number[] = [];
  for (let i = 1; i <= M; i++) {
    finalRoute.push(chunk[tour[i]].id);
  }
  return finalRoute;
}

solve();

declare const require: any;
const fs = require('fs');

function solve() {
  const input: string = fs.readFileSync(0, 'utf8');
  if (!input.trim()) {
    console.log(JSON.stringify({ firebreaks: [] }));
    return;
  }
  const data = JSON.parse(input);

  const width: number = data.width;
  const height: number = data.height;
  const grid: string[] = data.grid;
  const ignitions: [number, number][] = data.ignitions;
  const towns: { id: number; x: number; y: number; value: number }[] = data.towns;
  const cutBudget: number = data.cutBudget;

  // 1. Mark burnable cells
  const isBurnable = new Uint8Array(width * height);
  for (let y = 0; y < height; y++) {
    for (let x = 0; x < width; x++) {
      const c = y * width + x;
      if (grid[y][x] === '.') {
        isBurnable[c] = 1;
      }
    }
  }
  // Ignitions must be burnable (source of fire)
  for (const ign of ignitions) {
    const c = ign[1] * width + ign[0];
    isBurnable[c] = 1;
  }

  // 2. Find reachable cells from ignitions
  const reachable = new Uint8Array(width * height);
  const queue: number[] = [];
  for (const ign of ignitions) {
    const cell = ign[1] * width + ign[0];
    reachable[cell] = 1;
    queue.push(cell);
  }
  let head = 0;
  while (head < queue.length) {
    const cell = queue[head++];
    const x = cell % width;
    const y = Math.floor(cell / width);

    const tryNb = (nx: number, ny: number) => {
      const nb = ny * width + nx;
      if (grid[ny][nx] === '.' && !reachable[nb]) {
        reachable[nb] = 1;
        queue.push(nb);
      }
    };

    if (x > 0) tryNb(x - 1, y);
    if (x < width - 1) tryNb(x + 1, y);
    if (y > 0) tryNb(x, y - 1);
    if (y < height - 1) tryNb(x, y + 1);
  }

  const isIgnition = new Uint8Array(width * height);
  for (const ign of ignitions) {
    isIgnition[ign[1] * width + ign[0]] = 1;
  }

  // 3. Collect and sum town values by cell
  const townValue = new Float64Array(width * height);
  for (const t of towns) {
    const cell = t.y * width + t.x;
    if (reachable[cell] === 1 && !isIgnition[cell]) {
      townValue[cell] += t.value;
    }
  }

  const townCells: number[] = [];
  for (let c = 0; c < width * height; c++) {
    if (townValue[c] > 0) {
      townCells.push(c);
    }
  }

  if (cutBudget === 0 || townCells.length === 0) {
    console.log(JSON.stringify({ firebreaks: [] }));
    return;
  }

  townCells.sort((a, b) => townValue[b] - townValue[a]);

  // Set node capacities
  const capacity = new Float64Array(width * height);
  for (let c = 0; c < width * height; c++) {
    if (isIgnition[c]) {
      capacity[c] = Infinity;
    } else if (townValue[c] > 0) {
      capacity[c] = Infinity;
    } else {
      capacity[c] = 1;
    }
  }

  // Allocate visited and parentState arrays once
  const parentState = new Int32Array(2 * width * height);
  const visited = new Int32Array(2 * width * height);
  let visitedToken = 0;

  function runFlowWithState(
    targetSinks: Uint8Array,
    initialState: any
  ): any {
    const flow = initialState.flow.slice();
    const pred = initialState.pred.slice();
    const succ = initialState.succ.slice();
    let totalFlow = initialState.totalFlow;

    while (true) {
      if (totalFlow > cutBudget) {
        return null;
      }

      visitedToken++;

      const queue: number[] = [];
      for (const ign of ignitions) {
        const cell = ign[1] * width + ign[0];
        const state = (cell << 1) | 1;
        visited[state] = visitedToken;
        parentState[state] = -1;
        queue.push(state);
      }

      let foundSinkState = -1;
      let head = 0;

      while (head < queue.length) {
        const state = queue[head++];
        const cell = state >> 1;
        const isOut = (state & 1) === 1;

        if (!isOut && targetSinks[cell]) {
          foundSinkState = state;
          break;
        }

        if (!isOut) {
          if (capacity[cell] === Infinity || flow[cell] === 0) {
            const nextState = (cell << 1) | 1;
            if (visited[nextState] !== visitedToken) {
              visited[nextState] = visitedToken;
              parentState[nextState] = state;
              queue.push(nextState);
            }
          }
          if (capacity[cell] === 1 && flow[cell] === 1) {
            const p = pred[cell];
            if (p !== -1) {
              const nextState = (p << 1) | 1;
              if (visited[nextState] !== visitedToken) {
                visited[nextState] = visitedToken;
                parentState[nextState] = state;
                queue.push(nextState);
              }
            }
          }
        } else {
          if (capacity[cell] === 1 && flow[cell] === 1) {
            const nextState = cell << 1;
            if (visited[nextState] !== visitedToken) {
              visited[nextState] = visitedToken;
              parentState[nextState] = state;
              queue.push(nextState);
            }
          }

          const x = cell % width;
          const y = Math.floor(cell / width);
          const succCell = succ[cell];

          const tryNeighbor = (nx: number, ny: number) => {
            const nb = ny * width + nx;
            if (isBurnable[nb]) {
              if (capacity[cell] === Infinity || succCell !== nb) {
                const nextState = nb << 1;
                if (visited[nextState] !== visitedToken) {
                  visited[nextState] = visitedToken;
                  parentState[nextState] = state;
                  queue.push(nextState);
                }
              }
            }
          };

          if (x > 0) tryNeighbor(x - 1, y);
          if (x < width - 1) tryNeighbor(x + 1, y);
          if (y > 0) tryNeighbor(x, y - 1);
          if (y < height - 1) tryNeighbor(x, y + 1);
        }
      }

      if (foundSinkState === -1) {
        break;
      }

      const path: number[] = [];
      let curr = foundSinkState;
      while (curr !== -1) {
        path.push(curr);
        curr = parentState[curr];
      }
      path.reverse();

      for (let i = 0; i < path.length; i++) {
        const state = path[i];
        const cell = state >> 1;
        const isOut = (state & 1) === 1;

        if (!isOut && i + 1 < path.length && path[i + 1] === ((cell << 1) | 1)) {
          if (capacity[cell] === 1) {
            const p = path[i - 1] >> 1;
            const s = path[i + 2] >> 1;
            flow[cell] = 1;
            pred[cell] = p;
            succ[cell] = s;
          }
          i++;
        } else if (isOut && i + 1 < path.length && path[i + 1] === (cell << 1)) {
          if (capacity[cell] === 1) {
            flow[cell] = 0;
            pred[cell] = -1;
            succ[cell] = -1;
          }
          i++;
        }
      }

      totalFlow++;
    }

    return { flow, pred, succ, totalFlow };
  }

  function runFlow(targetSinks: Uint8Array): any {
    const initialState = {
      flow: new Int32Array(width * height),
      pred: new Int32Array(width * height),
      succ: new Int32Array(width * height),
      totalFlow: 0
    };
    initialState.pred.fill(-1);
    initialState.succ.fill(-1);
    return runFlowWithState(targetSinks, initialState);
  }

  function findReachableStates(
    flow: any,
    pred: any,
    succ: any
  ): Uint8Array {
    visitedToken++;
    const queue: number[] = [];

    for (const ign of ignitions) {
      const cell = ign[1] * width + ign[0];
      const state = (cell << 1) | 1;
      visited[state] = visitedToken;
      queue.push(state);
    }

    let head = 0;
    while (head < queue.length) {
      const state = queue[head++];
      const cell = state >> 1;
      const isOut = (state & 1) === 1;

      if (!isOut) {
        if (capacity[cell] === Infinity || flow[cell] === 0) {
          const nextState = (cell << 1) | 1;
          if (visited[nextState] !== visitedToken) {
            visited[nextState] = visitedToken;
            queue.push(nextState);
          }
        }
        if (capacity[cell] === 1 && flow[cell] === 1) {
          const p = pred[cell];
          if (p !== -1) {
            const nextState = (p << 1) | 1;
            if (visited[nextState] !== visitedToken) {
              visited[nextState] = visitedToken;
              queue.push(nextState);
            }
          }
        }
      } else {
        if (capacity[cell] === 1 && flow[cell] === 1) {
          const nextState = cell << 1;
          if (visited[nextState] !== visitedToken) {
            visited[nextState] = visitedToken;
            queue.push(nextState);
          }
        }

        const x = cell % width;
        const y = Math.floor(cell / width);
        const succCell = succ[cell];

        const tryNeighbor = (nx: number, ny: number) => {
          const nb = ny * width + nx;
          if (isBurnable[nb]) {
            if (capacity[cell] === Infinity || succCell !== nb) {
              const nextState = nb << 1;
              if (visited[nextState] !== visitedToken) {
                visited[nextState] = visitedToken;
                queue.push(nextState);
              }
            }
          }
        };

        if (x > 0) tryNeighbor(x - 1, y);
        if (x < width - 1) tryNeighbor(x + 1, y);
        if (y > 0) tryNeighbor(x, y - 1);
        if (y < height - 1) tryNeighbor(x, y + 1);
      }
    }

    const S_reach = new Uint8Array(2 * width * height);
    for (let i = 0; i < 2 * width * height; i++) {
      if (visited[i] === visitedToken) {
        S_reach[i] = 1;
      }
    }
    return S_reach;
  }

  // First try to save all reachable towns
  const allSinks = new Uint8Array(width * height);
  for (const c of townCells) {
    allSinks[c] = 1;
  }

  const allState = runFlow(allSinks);

  let finalFlowState = allState;

  if (allState === null) {
    // Cannot save all towns within budget, run greedy algorithm
    const candidates = townCells.slice(0, 100);

    let bestFlowState = {
      flow: new Int32Array(width * height),
      pred: new Int32Array(width * height),
      succ: new Int32Array(width * height),
      totalFlow: 0
    };
    bestFlowState.pred.fill(-1);
    bestFlowState.succ.fill(-1);

    const activeSinks = new Uint8Array(width * height);

    while (true) {
      let bestCandidate = -1;
      let bestRatio = -1;
      let bestCandidateState = null;

      for (const c of candidates) {
        if (activeSinks[c]) continue;

        activeSinks[c] = 1;
        const testState = runFlowWithState(activeSinks, bestFlowState);
        activeSinks[c] = 0;

        if (testState !== null) {
          const delta = testState.totalFlow - bestFlowState.totalFlow;
          const cost = delta === 0 ? 1e-6 : delta;
          const ratio = townValue[c] / cost;
          if (ratio > bestRatio) {
            bestRatio = ratio;
            bestCandidate = c;
            bestCandidateState = testState;
          }
        }
      }

      if (bestCandidate === -1) {
        break;
      }

      activeSinks[bestCandidate] = 1;
      bestFlowState = bestCandidateState!;
    }

    finalFlowState = bestFlowState;
  }

  // Reconstruct the cut cells
  const S_reach = findReachableStates(
    finalFlowState!.flow,
    finalFlowState!.pred,
    finalFlowState!.succ
  );

  const cutCells: number[] = [];
  for (let c = 0; c < width * height; c++) {
    if (capacity[c] === 1 && S_reach[c << 1] === 1 && S_reach[(c << 1) | 1] === 0) {
      cutCells.push(c);
    }
  }

  const firebreaks = cutCells.map(c => {
    const x = c % width;
    const y = Math.floor(c / width);
    return [x, y];
  });

  console.log(JSON.stringify({ firebreaks }));
}
