declare const require: any;
const fs = require('fs');

interface Robot {
  id: number;
  x: number;
  y: number;
}

interface Job {
  id: number;
  x: number;
  y: number;
  priority: number;
}

interface InputData {
  grid: string[];
  robots: Robot[];
  jobs: Job[];
}

function solve() {
  const programStartTime = Date.now();

  let input: string;
  try {
    input = fs.readFileSync(0, 'utf8');
  } catch (e) {
    return;
  }
  if (!input) return;
  const data: InputData = JSON.parse(input);

  const grid = data.grid;
  const robots = data.robots;
  const jobs = data.jobs;

  const H = grid.length;
  if (H === 0) {
    console.log(JSON.stringify({ assignments: [] }));
    return;
  }
  const W = grid[0].length;
  if (W === 0) {
    console.log(JSON.stringify({ assignments: [] }));
    return;
  }

  const R = robots.length;
  const J = jobs.length;
  const N = R + J;

  // Flattened blocked representation
  const blocked = new Uint8Array(W * H);
  for (let y = 0; y < H; y++) {
    const row = grid[y];
    for (let x = 0; x < W; x++) {
      if (row[x] === '#') {
        blocked[y * W + x] = 1;
      }
    }
  }

  // Node coordinates and indices
  const nodeX = new Int32Array(N);
  const nodeY = new Int32Array(N);
  const nodeIdx = new Int32Array(N);

  for (let r = 0; r < R; r++) {
    nodeX[r] = robots[r].x;
    nodeY[r] = robots[r].y;
    nodeIdx[r] = robots[r].y * W + robots[r].x;
  }
  for (let j = 0; j < J; j++) {
    nodeX[R + j] = jobs[j].x;
    nodeY[R + j] = jobs[j].y;
    nodeIdx[R + j] = jobs[j].y * W + jobs[j].x;
  }

  // Distance matrix cache: N arrays of size N, allocated lazily
  const distCache: (Int32Array | null)[] = Array.from({ length: N }, () => null);

  // Pre-allocated BFS structures
  let runId = 0;
  const visited = new Int32Array(W * H);
  const dist = new Int32Array(W * H);
  const queue = new Int32Array(W * H);

  function runBFS(u: number) {
    if (distCache[u] === null) {
      distCache[u] = new Int32Array(N);
      distCache[u]!.fill(-2);
    }
    const uArr = distCache[u]!;

    runId++;
    const startIdx = nodeIdx[u];
    
    visited[startIdx] = runId;
    dist[startIdx] = 0;
    
    let head = 0;
    let tail = 0;
    queue[tail++] = startIdx;
    
    while (head < tail) {
      const curr = queue[head++];
      const d = dist[curr];
      const currX = curr % W;
      const currY = (curr / W) | 0;
      
      // Left
      if (currX > 0) {
        const next = curr - 1;
        if (!blocked[next] && visited[next] !== runId) {
          visited[next] = runId;
          dist[next] = d + 1;
          queue[tail++] = next;
        }
      }
      // Right
      if (currX < W - 1) {
        const next = curr + 1;
        if (!blocked[next] && visited[next] !== runId) {
          visited[next] = runId;
          dist[next] = d + 1;
          queue[tail++] = next;
        }
      }
      // Up
      if (currY > 0) {
        const next = curr - W;
        if (!blocked[next] && visited[next] !== runId) {
          visited[next] = runId;
          dist[next] = d + 1;
          queue[tail++] = next;
        }
      }
      // Down
      if (currY < H - 1) {
        const next = curr + W;
        if (!blocked[next] && visited[next] !== runId) {
          visited[next] = runId;
          dist[next] = d + 1;
          queue[tail++] = next;
        }
      }
    }
    
    // Populate distMatrix for u to all v
    for (let v = 0; v < N; v++) {
      const vIdx = nodeIdx[v];
      const d = (visited[vIdx] === runId) ? dist[vIdx] : -1;
      uArr[v] = d;
      if (distCache[v] !== null) {
        distCache[v]![u] = d;
      }
    }
  }

  function getDist(u: number, v: number): number {
    if (distCache[u] !== null && distCache[u]![v] !== -2) {
      return distCache[u]![v];
    }
    if (distCache[v] !== null && distCache[v]![u] !== -2) {
      return distCache[v]![u];
    }
    runBFS(u);
    return distCache[u]![v];
  }

  function pathDist(r: number, path: number[]): number {
    if (path.length === 0) return 0;
    let d = getDist(r, path[0]);
    if (d === -1) return Infinity;
    for (let i = 0; i < path.length - 1; i++) {
      const step = getDist(path[i], path[i + 1]);
      if (step === -1) return Infinity;
      d += step;
    }
    return d;
  }

  function calculateTotalDistance(assignments: number[][]): number {
    let total = 0;
    for (let r = 0; r < R; r++) {
      const d = pathDist(r, assignments[r]);
      if (d === Infinity) return Infinity;
      total += d;
    }
    return total;
  }

  // Greedy Strategy 1: Global Nearest Neighbor
  function greedyGlobal(priorityOrder: 'none' | 'desc' | 'asc'): number[][] {
    const assignments: number[][] = Array.from({ length: R }, () => []);
    const currentPos = new Int32Array(R);
    for (let r = 0; r < R; r++) currentPos[r] = r;
    
    const assigned = new Uint8Array(N);
    let assignedCount = 0;
    
    if (priorityOrder === 'none') {
      while (assignedCount < J) {
        let bestDist = Infinity;
        let bestR = -1;
        let bestJ = -1;
        
        for (let r = 0; r < R; r++) {
          const u = currentPos[r];
          for (let j = R; j < N; j++) {
            if (assigned[j]) continue;
            const d = getDist(u, j);
            if (d === -1) continue;
            if (d < bestDist) {
              bestDist = d;
              bestR = r;
              bestJ = j;
            } else if (d === bestDist) {
              if (bestJ === -1 || jobs[j - R].priority > jobs[bestJ - R].priority) {
                bestR = r;
                bestJ = j;
              }
            }
          }
        }
        
        if (bestJ === -1) {
          for (let j = R; j < N; j++) {
            if (!assigned[j]) {
              assignments[0].push(j);
              assigned[j] = 1;
              assignedCount++;
            }
          }
          break;
        }
        
        assignments[bestR].push(bestJ);
        currentPos[bestR] = bestJ;
        assigned[bestJ] = 1;
        assignedCount++;
      }
    } else {
      const sortedJobs = jobs.map((job, idx) => ({ job, nodeIdx: R + idx }));
      if (priorityOrder === 'desc') {
        sortedJobs.sort((a, b) => b.job.priority - a.job.priority || a.nodeIdx - b.nodeIdx);
      } else {
        sortedJobs.sort((a, b) => a.job.priority - b.job.priority || a.nodeIdx - b.nodeIdx);
      }
      
      for (const item of sortedJobs) {
        const j = item.nodeIdx;
        let bestDist = Infinity;
        let bestR = 0;
        for (let r = 0; r < R; r++) {
          const u = currentPos[r];
          const d = getDist(u, j);
          if (d !== -1 && d < bestDist) {
            bestDist = d;
            bestR = r;
          }
        }
        assignments[bestR].push(j);
        currentPos[bestR] = j;
        assigned[j] = 1;
        assignedCount++;
      }
    }
    
    return assignments;
  }

  // Greedy Strategy 2: Round Robin Nearest Neighbor
  function greedyRoundRobin(): number[][] {
    const assignments: number[][] = Array.from({ length: R }, () => []);
    const currentPos = new Int32Array(R);
    for (let r = 0; r < R; r++) currentPos[r] = r;
    
    const assigned = new Uint8Array(N);
    let assignedCount = 0;
    
    while (assignedCount < J) {
      let progress = false;
      for (let r = 0; r < R; r++) {
        const u = currentPos[r];
        let bestDist = Infinity;
        let bestJ = -1;
        for (let j = R; j < N; j++) {
          if (assigned[j]) continue;
          const d = getDist(u, j);
          if (d !== -1 && d < bestDist) {
            bestDist = d;
            bestJ = j;
          }
        }
        if (bestJ !== -1) {
          assignments[r].push(bestJ);
          currentPos[r] = bestJ;
          assigned[bestJ] = 1;
          assignedCount++;
          progress = true;
        }
      }
      if (!progress) {
        for (let j = R; j < N; j++) {
          if (!assigned[j]) {
            assignments[0].push(j);
            assigned[j] = 1;
            assignedCount++;
          }
        }
        break;
      }
    }
    return assignments;
  }

  // Greedy Strategy 3: Static Closest
  function greedyStaticClosest(): number[][] {
    const assignments: number[][] = Array.from({ length: R }, () => []);
    
    for (let j = R; j < N; j++) {
      let bestDist = Infinity;
      let bestR = 0;
      for (let r = 0; r < R; r++) {
        const d = getDist(r, j);
        if (d !== -1 && d < bestDist) {
          bestDist = d;
          bestR = r;
        }
      }
      assignments[bestR].push(j);
    }
    
    for (let r = 0; r < R; r++) {
      const path = assignments[r];
      if (path.length <= 1) continue;
      const sortedPath: number[] = [];
      let curr = r;
      const pathSet = new Set(path);
      while (pathSet.size > 0) {
        let bestDist = Infinity;
        let bestNext = -1;
        for (const j of pathSet) {
          const d = getDist(curr, j);
          if (d !== -1 && d < bestDist) {
            bestDist = d;
            bestNext = j;
          }
        }
        if (bestNext === -1) {
          for (const j of pathSet) {
            sortedPath.push(j);
          }
          break;
        }
        sortedPath.push(bestNext);
        pathSet.delete(bestNext);
        curr = bestNext;
      }
      assignments[r] = sortedPath;
    }
    return assignments;
  }

  // Evaluate candidate initializations
  const candidates = [
    greedyGlobal('none'),
    greedyGlobal('desc'),
    greedyGlobal('asc'),
    greedyRoundRobin(),
    greedyStaticClosest()
  ];

  let bestInitialDist = Infinity;
  let bestAssignments = candidates[0];

  for (const cand of candidates) {
    const d = calculateTotalDistance(cand);
    if (d < bestInitialDist) {
      bestInitialDist = d;
      bestAssignments = cand;
    }
  }

  // Local Search (2-opt, Relocate, Swap)
  function shuffle(array: number[]) {
    for (let i = array.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
      const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
      const temp = array[i];
      array[i] = array[j];
      array[j] = temp;
    }
  }

  function runLocalSearch(initAssignments: number[][], maxTimeMs: number): number[][] {
    const startTime = Date.now();
    let current = initAssignments.map(path => [...path]);
    
    const pathDistances = new Int32Array(R);
    for (let r = 0; r < R; r++) {
      pathDistances[r] = pathDist(r, current[r]);
    }
    
    const robotIndices = Array.from({ length: R }, (_, i) => i);
    let improved = true;
    let timedOut = false;
    
    while (improved && !timedOut) {
      improved = false;
      shuffle(robotIndices);
      
      // 1. Intra-route 2-opt
      for (const r of robotIndices) {
        if (Date.now() - startTime > maxTimeMs) {
          timedOut = true;
          break;
        }
        const path = current[r];
        if (path.length < 3) continue;
        
        let bestRDist = pathDistances[r];
        let bestI = -1;
        let bestJ = -1;
        
        for (let i = 0; i < path.length - 1; i++) {
          for (let j = i + 1; j < path.length; j++) {
            const oldD = (i > 0 ? getDist(path[i - 1], path[i]) : getDist(r, path[0]))
                       + (j < path.length - 1 ? getDist(path[j], path[j + 1]) : 0);
            
            const newD = (i > 0 ? getDist(path[i - 1], path[j]) : getDist(r, path[j]))
                       + (j < path.length - 1 ? getDist(path[i], path[j + 1]) : 0);
            
            const newRDist = pathDistances[r] - oldD + newD;
            if (newRDist < bestRDist) {
              bestRDist = newRDist;
              bestI = i;
              bestJ = j;
            }
          }
        }
        
        if (bestI !== -1) {
          let left = bestI;
          let right = bestJ;
          while (left < right) {
            const temp = path[left];
            path[left] = path[right];
            path[right] = temp;
            left++;
            right--;
          }
          pathDistances[r] = bestRDist;
          improved = true;
        }
      }
      if (timedOut) break;
      if (improved) continue;
      
      // 2. Relocate a job
      for (const r1 of robotIndices) {
        if (Date.now() - startTime > maxTimeMs) {
          timedOut = true;
          break;
        }
        const p1 = current[r1];
        if (p1.length === 0) continue;
        
        const idxs1 = Array.from({ length: p1.length }, (_, i) => i);
        shuffle(idxs1);
        
        for (const idx1 of idxs1) {
          if (Date.now() - startTime > maxTimeMs) {
            timedOut = true;
            break;
          }
          const job = p1[idx1];
          
          const r2s = [...robotIndices];
          for (const r2 of r2s) {
            if (Date.now() - startTime > maxTimeMs) {
              timedOut = true;
              break;
            }
            const p2 = current[r2];
            
            if (r1 === r2) {
              if (p1.length < 2) continue;
              for (let idx2 = 0; idx2 <= p1.length; idx2++) {
                if (idx2 === idx1 || idx2 === idx1 + 1) continue;
                
                const newP = [...p1];
                newP.splice(idx1, 1);
                const insertIdx = idx2 > idx1 ? idx2 - 1 : idx2;
                newP.splice(insertIdx, 0, job);
                
                const newD = pathDist(r1, newP);
                if (newD < pathDistances[r1]) {
                  current[r1] = newP;
                  pathDistances[r1] = newD;
                  improved = true;
                  break;
                }
              }
            } else {
              for (let idx2 = 0; idx2 <= p2.length; idx2++) {
                const newP1 = [...p1];
                newP1.splice(idx1, 1);
                
                const newP2 = [...p2];
                newP2.splice(idx2, 0, job);
                
                const newD1 = pathDist(r1, newP1);
                const newD2 = pathDist(r2, newP2);
                
                if (newD1 !== Infinity && newD2 !== Infinity && (newD1 + newD2) < (pathDistances[r1] + pathDistances[r2])) {
                  current[r1] = newP1;
                  current[r2] = newP2;
                  pathDistances[r1] = newD1;
                  pathDistances[r2] = newD2;
                  improved = true;
                  break;
                }
              }
            }
            if (improved || timedOut) break;
          }
          if (improved || timedOut) break;
        }
        if (improved || timedOut) break;
      }
      if (timedOut) break;
      if (improved) continue;
      
      // 3. Swap two jobs
      for (const r1 of robotIndices) {
        if (Date.now() - startTime > maxTimeMs) {
          timedOut = true;
          break;
        }
        const p1 = current[r1];
        if (p1.length === 0) continue;
        
        for (let idx1 = 0; idx1 < p1.length; idx1++) {
          if (Date.now() - startTime > maxTimeMs) {
            timedOut = true;
            break;
          }
          
          for (const r2 of robotIndices) {
            if (r2 <= r1) continue;
            if (Date.now() - startTime > maxTimeMs) {
              timedOut = true;
              break;
            }
            const p2 = current[r2];
            if (p2.length === 0) continue;
            
            for (let idx2 = 0; idx2 < p2.length; idx2++) {
              const job1 = p1[idx1];
              const job2 = p2[idx2];
              
              const newP1 = [...p1];
              newP1[idx1] = job2;
              
              const newP2 = [...p2];
              newP2[idx2] = job1;
              
              const newD1 = pathDist(r1, newP1);
              const newD2 = pathDist(r2, newP2);
              
              if (newD1 !== Infinity && newD2 !== Infinity && (newD1 + newD2) < (pathDistances[r1] + pathDistances[r2])) {
                current[r1] = newP1;
                current[r2] = newP2;
                pathDistances[r1] = newD1;
                pathDistances[r2] = newD2;
                improved = true;
                break;
              }
            }
            if (improved || timedOut) break;
          }
          if (improved || timedOut) break;
        }
        if (improved || timedOut) break;
      }
    }
    return current;
  }

  // Budget remaining time for local search safely
  const maxLocalSearchTime = Math.min(2000, Math.max(100, 4500 - (Date.now() - programStartTime)));
  const optimizedAssignments = runLocalSearch(bestAssignments, maxLocalSearchTime);

  // Map to final output
  const maxRobotId = Math.max(...robots.map(r => r.id));
  const outputAssignments: number[][] = Array.from({ length: maxRobotId + 1 }, () => []);
  
  for (let r = 0; r < R; r++) {
    const robotId = robots[r].id;
    outputAssignments[robotId] = optimizedAssignments[r].map(nodeIdx => jobs[nodeIdx - R].id);
  }

  console.log(JSON.stringify({ assignments: outputAssignments }));
}

solve();


**Input format:**

declare const require: any;
const fs = require('fs');

interface Drone {
  id: number;
  x: number;
  y: number;
}

interface InputData {
  probability: number[][];
  drones: Drone[];
  maxStepsPerDrone: number;
}

function solve() {
  const input: string = fs.readFileSync(0, 'utf8');
  if (!input.trim()) {
    console.log(JSON.stringify({ paths: [] }));
    return;
  }
  const data: InputData = JSON.parse(input);

  const probability = data.probability;
  const drones = data.drones;
  const maxStepsPerDrone = data.maxStepsPerDrone;

  const H = probability.length;
  if (H === 0) {
    console.log(JSON.stringify({ paths: [] }));
    return;
  }
  const W = probability[0].length;
  if (W === 0) {
    console.log(JSON.stringify({ paths: Array(drones.length).fill([]) }));
    return;
  }

  // Pre-collect starting cells' probabilities and set them to 0
  for (const drone of drones) {
    if (drone.y >= 0 && drone.y < H && drone.x >= 0 && drone.x < W) {
      if (probability[drone.y][drone.x] > 0) {
        probability[drone.y][drone.x] = 0;
      }
    }
  }

  const decay = 0.9;
  const K = 30; // Diffusion iterations
  
  // Decide lookahead depth L based on scale of problem
  const totalSteps = drones.length * maxStepsPerDrone;
  let L = 5;
  if (totalSteps > 10000) {
    L = 4;
  }
  if (totalSteps > 50000) {
    L = 3;
  }
  L = Math.min(L, maxStepsPerDrone);

  // We will plan paths sequentially for each drone
  const paths: [number, number][][] = [];

  // Setup diffusion function
  function computeDiffusion(prob: number[][]): Float64Array[] {
    let current = Array.from({ length: H }, (_, y) => {
      const arr = new Float64Array(W);
      for (let x = 0; x < W; x++) {
        arr[x] = prob[y][x] < 0 ? 0 : prob[y][x];
      }
      return arr;
    });
    let next = Array.from({ length: H }, () => new Float64Array(W));
    
    const dx = [0, 0, -1, 1];
    const dy = [-1, 1, 0, 0];
    
    for (let iter = 0; iter < K; iter++) {
      let changed = false;
      for (let y = 0; y < H; y++) {
        for (let x = 0; x < W; x++) {
          if (prob[y][x] < 0) {
            next[y][x] = 0;
            continue;
          }
          let maxNeighbor = 0;
          for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            const nx = x + dx[i];
            const ny = y + dy[i];
            if (nx >= 0 && nx < W && ny >= 0 && ny < H && prob[ny][nx] >= 0) {
              if (current[ny][nx] > maxNeighbor) {
                maxNeighbor = current[ny][nx];
              }
            }
          }
          const val = Math.max(current[y][x], decay * maxNeighbor);
          next[y][x] = val;
          if (Math.abs(val - current[y][x]) > 1e-6) {
            changed = true;
          }
        }
      }
      const temp = current;
      current = next;
      next = temp;
      if (!changed) break;
    }
    return current;
  }

  // Determine recompute interval for diffusion
  const N = W * H;
  const maxOps = 5000000;
  const totalDiffOps = totalSteps * K * N;
  let recomputeInterval = Math.max(1, Math.floor(totalDiffOps / maxOps));
  // Recompute at least 10 times per drone
  recomputeInterval = Math.min(recomputeInterval, Math.max(1, Math.floor(maxStepsPerDrone / 10)));

  let stepsSinceRecompute = recomputeInterval;
  let diffused = Array.from({ length: H }, () => new Float64Array(W));

  const dx = [0, 0, 0, -1, 1];
  const dy = [0, -1, 1, 0, 0];

  const dfsVisited = new Uint8Array(H * W);

  for (let d = 0; d < drones.length; d++) {
    const drone = drones[d];
    let cx = drone.x;
    let cy = drone.y;

    const path: [number, number][] = [[cx, cy]];
    const visitedCount = new Uint32Array(H * W);
    visitedCount[cy * W + cx] = 1;

    for (let step = 0; step < maxStepsPerDrone; step++) {
      // Recompute diffusion if interval reached
      if (stepsSinceRecompute >= recomputeInterval || step === 0) {
        diffused = computeDiffusion(probability);
        stepsSinceRecompute = 0;
      }

      const currentL = Math.min(L, maxStepsPerDrone - step);
      if (currentL <= 0) break;

      let bestMoveX = cx;
      let bestMoveY = cy;
      let bestScore = -Infinity;

      // DFS helper
      function dfs(x: number, y: number, depth: number, currentSum: number, pathLength: number): number {
        if (depth === 0) {
          const idx = y * W + x;
          const count = visitedCount[idx] + (dfsVisited[idx] ? 1 : 0);
          const effDiffused = diffused[y][x] / (1 + count);
          return currentSum + Math.pow(decay, pathLength) * effDiffused;
        }

        let maxScore = -Infinity;
        for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
          const nx = x + dx[i];
          const ny = y + dy[i];
          if (nx >= 0 && nx < W && ny >= 0 && ny < H && probability[ny][nx] !== -1) {
            const nidx = ny * W + nx;
            const wasVisited = dfsVisited[nidx] !== 0;

            let addedVal = 0;
            if (!wasVisited) {
              addedVal = probability[ny][nx] * Math.pow(decay, pathLength + 1);
              dfsVisited[nidx] = 1;
            }

            const score = dfs(nx, ny, depth - 1, currentSum + addedVal, pathLength + 1);
            if (score > maxScore) {
              maxScore = score;
            }

            if (!wasVisited) {
              dfsVisited[nidx] = 0;
            }
          }
        }
        return maxScore;
      }

      // Evaluate the first step moves
      for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        const nx = cx + dx[i];
        const ny = cy + dy[i];
        if (nx >= 0 && nx < W && ny >= 0 && ny < H && probability[ny][nx] !== -1) {
          const nidx = ny * W + nx;
          const wasVisited = dfsVisited[nidx] !== 0;

          let addedVal = 0;
          if (!wasVisited) {
            addedVal = probability[ny][nx] * decay;
            dfsVisited[nidx] = 1;
          }

          const score = dfs(nx, ny, currentL - 1, addedVal, 1);
          if (score > bestScore) {
            bestScore = score;
            bestMoveX = nx;
            bestMoveY = ny;
          }

          if (!wasVisited) {
            dfsVisited[nidx] = 0;
          }
        }
      }

      // Make the best move
      cx = bestMoveX;
      cy = bestMoveY;
      path.push([cx, cy]);
      visitedCount[cy * W + cx]++;
      probability[cy][cx] = 0; // mark as collected
      stepsSinceRecompute++;
    }

    paths.push(path);
  }

  console.log(JSON.stringify({ paths }));
}

solve();

Typical Prompt:
Write a complete Node.js TypeScript program for this benchmark task.

Schedule mission-control work across parallel workstations.

The input JSON contains:
- `machineCount`
- `tasks`: objects `{id, duration, deps, deadline, weight}`

A task may start only after every dependency has finished. Return either:
```
{"schedule": [{"id": taskId, "start": integerTime, "machine": machineIndex}, ...]}
```

declare const require: any;
const fs = require('fs');

interface Task {
    id: string | number;
    duration: number;
    deps: (string | number)[];
    deadline: number;
    weight: number;
}

interface ScheduleItem {
    id: string | number;
    start: number;
    machine: number;
}

class MinHeap<T> {
    private data: T[] = [];
    private compare: (a: T, b: T) => number;
    constructor(compare: (a: T, b: T) => number) {
        this.compare = compare;
    }
    push(val: T) {
        this.data.push(val);
        this.up(this.data.length - 1);
    }
    pop(): T | undefined {
        if (this.data.length === 0) return undefined;
        const top = this.data[0];
        const bottom = this.data.pop()!;
        if (this.data.length > 0) {
            this.data[0] = bottom;
            this.down(0);
        }
        return top;
    }
    peek(): T | undefined {
        return this.data[0];
    }
    size(): number {
        return this.data.length;
    }
    private up(i: number) {
        while (i > 0) {
            const p = (i - 1) >> 1;
            if (this.compare(this.data[i], this.data[p]) < 0) {
                const tmp = this.data[i];
                this.data[i] = this.data[p];
                this.data[p] = tmp;
                i = p;
            } else {
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    private down(i: number) {
        const len = this.data.length;
        while ((i << 1) + 1 < len) {
            let left = (i << 1) + 1;
            let right = left + 1;
            let best = i;
            if (this.compare(this.data[left], this.data[best]) < 0) best = left;
            if (right < len && this.compare(this.data[right], this.data[best]) < 0) best = right;
            if (best !== i) {
                const tmp = this.data[i];
                this.data[i] = this.data[best];
                this.data[best] = tmp;
                i = best;
            } else {
                break;
            }
        }
    }
}

function solve(inputJson: string): string {
    const data = JSON.parse(inputJson);
    const machineCount: number = data.machineCount;
    const taskList: Task[] = data.tasks;
    const N = taskList.length;

    // Map task ID to 0..N-1 index
    const idToIndex = new Map<string | number, number>();
    const indexToId: (string | number)[] = new Array(N);
    for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
        const id = taskList[i].id;
        idToIndex.set(id, i);
        indexToId[i] = id;
    }

    // Flat arrays for task properties
    const durations = new Int32Array(N);
    const deadlines = new Float64Array(N);
    const weights = new Float64Array(N);
    for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
        durations[i] = taskList[i].duration;
        deadlines[i] = taskList[i].deadline;
        weights[i] = taskList[i].weight;
    }

    // Build adjacency lists using indices
    const predecessors: number[][] = new Array(N);
    const successors: number[][] = new Array(N);
    for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
        predecessors[i] = [];
        successors[i] = [];
    }

    const inDegreeBase = new Int32Array(N);
    for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
        let validDepsCount = 0;
        for (const depId of taskList[i].deps) {
            const depIdx = idToIndex.get(depId);
            if (depIdx !== undefined) {
                predecessors[i].push(depIdx);
                successors[depIdx].push(i);
                validDepsCount++;
            }
        }
        inDegreeBase[i] = validDepsCount;
    }

    // Precalculate static metrics using iterative topological sort (to avoid stack overflow)
    const cpMap = new Float64Array(N);
    const outDegree = new Int32Array(N);
    const maxSuccCP = new Float64Array(N);

    for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
        outDegree[i] = successors[i].length;
    }

    const queueCP = new Int32Array(N);
    let qCPHead = 0;
    let qCPTail = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
        if (outDegree[i] === 0) {
            cpMap[i] = durations[i];
            queueCP[qCPTail++] = i;
        }
    }

    while (qCPHead < qCPTail) {
        const curr = queueCP[qCPHead++];
        const currCP = cpMap[curr];
        const preds = predecessors[curr];
        for (let j = 0; j < preds.length; j++) {
            const P = preds[j];
            outDegree[P]--;
            if (currCP > maxSuccCP[P]) {
                maxSuccCP[P] = currCP;
            }
            if (outDegree[P] === 0) {
                cpMap[P] = durations[P] + maxSuccCP[P];
                queueCP[qCPTail++] = P;
            }
        }
    }

    // Handle unreachable/cyclic nodes
    for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
        if (cpMap[i] === 0 && durations[i] > 0) {
            cpMap[i] = durations[i];
        }
    }

    // Compute descendant metrics (exact for small N, fallback to immediate successors for large N)
    const descDurMap = new Float64Array(N);
    const descCountMap = new Int32Array(N);

    if (N <= 2000) {
        const visited = new Uint8Array(N);
        const q = new Int32Array(N);
        for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            visited.fill(0);
            visited[i] = 1;
            q[0] = i;
            let qHead = 0;
            let qTail = 1;
            let totalDur = 0;
            while (qHead < qTail) {
                const curr = q[qHead++];
                totalDur += durations[curr];
                const succs = successors[curr];
                for (let j = 0; j < succs.length; j++) {
                    const S = succs[j];
                    if (visited[S] === 0) {
                        visited[S] = 1;
                        q[qTail++] = S;
                    }
                }
            }
            descDurMap[i] = totalDur;
            descCountMap[i] = qTail - 1;
        }
    } else {
        for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            let totalDur = 0;
            const succs = successors[i];
            for (let j = 0; j < succs.length; j++) {
                totalDur += durations[succs[j]];
            }
            descDurMap[i] = totalDur;
            descCountMap[i] = succs.length;
        }
    }

    // Preallocate reusable simulation structures
    const inDegree = new Int32Array(N);
    const completed = new Float64Array(N);

    function runSimulation(priorityArray: Float64Array): { schedule: ScheduleItem[]; cost: number } {
        inDegree.set(inDegreeBase);
        completed.fill(-1);

        const RArray = new Float64Array(N);
        const taskMachine = new Int32Array(N);

        const availableReady = new MinHeap<number>((a, b) => priorityArray[b] - priorityArray[a]);
        const pendingReady = new MinHeap<number>((a, b) => RArray[a] - RArray[b]);
        const runningTasks = new MinHeap<number>((a, b) => completed[a] - completed[b]);

        const idleMachines: number[] = [];
        for (let m = 0; m < machineCount; m++) {
            idleMachines.push(m);
        }

        for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            if (inDegree[i] === 0) {
                RArray[i] = 0;
                availableReady.push(i);
            }
        }

        let time = 0;
        const schedule: ScheduleItem[] = [];

        while (true) {
            while (pendingReady.size() > 0 && RArray[pendingReady.peek()!] <= time) {
                availableReady.push(pendingReady.pop()!);
            }

            while (idleMachines.length > 0 && availableReady.size() > 0) {
                const idx = availableReady.pop()!;
                const machine = idleMachines.pop()!;
                taskMachine[idx] = machine;
                completed[idx] = time + durations[idx];
                schedule.push({ id: indexToId[idx], start: time, machine });
                runningTasks.push(idx);
            }

            let nextTime = Infinity;
            if (runningTasks.size() > 0) {
                nextTime = Math.min(nextTime, completed[runningTasks.peek()!]);
            }
            if (idleMachines.length > 0 && pendingReady.size() > 0) {
                nextTime = Math.min(nextTime, RArray[pendingReady.peek()!]);
            }

            if (nextTime === Infinity) {
                break;
            }

            time = nextTime;

            while (runningTasks.size() > 0 && completed[runningTasks.peek()!] === time) {
                const idx = runningTasks.pop()!;
                idleMachines.push(taskMachine[idx]);

                const succs = successors[idx];
                for (let j = 0; j < succs.length; j++) {
                    const S = succs[j];
                    inDegree[S]--;
                    if (inDegree[S] === 0) {
                        let maxDepCompleted = 0;
                        const preds = predecessors[S];
                        for (let k = 0; k < preds.length; k++) {
                            const dep = preds[k];
                            if (completed[dep] > maxDepCompleted) {
                                maxDepCompleted = completed[dep];
                            }
                        }
                        RArray[S] = maxDepCompleted;
                        if (maxDepCompleted <= time) {
                            availableReady.push(S);
                        } else {
                            pendingReady.push(S);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        let makespan = 0;
        let weightedLateness = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            const comp = completed[i];
            if (comp > 0) {
                if (comp > makespan) makespan = comp;
                const lateness = Math.max(0, comp - deadlines[i]);
                weightedLateness += weights[i] * lateness;
            }
        }

        return { schedule, cost: makespan + weightedLateness };
    }

    // Build the heuristic arrays
    const heuristicGetters: { name: string; getVal: (i: number) => number; fast: boolean }[] = [
        { name: 'CP', getVal: (i) => cpMap[i], fast: true },
        { name: 'EDF', getVal: (i) => -deadlines[i], fast: true },
        { name: 'Weight', getVal: (i) => weights[i], fast: false },
        { name: 'WSPT', getVal: (i) => weights[i] / (durations[i] || 1), fast: true },
        { name: 'SPT', getVal: (i) => -durations[i], fast: false },
        { name: 'LPT', getVal: (i) => durations[i], fast: false },
        { name: 'DescDur', getVal: (i) => descDurMap[i], fast: false },
        { name: 'DescCount', getVal: (i) => descCountMap[i], fast: false },
        { name: 'Slack', getVal: (i) => -(deadlines[i] - durations[i]), fast: true },
        { name: 'Composite1', getVal: (i) => 10 * cpMap[i] - deadlines[i], fast: false },
        { name: 'Composite2', getVal: (i) => 10 * cpMap[i] + 10 * weights[i] - deadlines[i], fast: true },
        { name: 'Composite3', getVal: (i) => weights[i] * cpMap[i] - deadlines[i], fast: true },
        { name: 'Composite4', getVal: (i) => weights[i] / (deadlines[i] - durations[i] + 1), fast: false },
        { name: 'Composite5', getVal: (i) => -deadlines[i] / (weights[i] + 1), fast: false },
        { name: 'Composite6', getVal: (i) => cpMap[i] / (deadlines[i] + 1), fast: false },
        { name: 'Composite7', getVal: (i) => descDurMap[i] / (deadlines[i] + 1), fast: false },
        { name: 'Composite8', getVal: (i) => weights[i] * descDurMap[i] - deadlines[i], fast: false },
        { name: 'Composite9', getVal: (i) => weights[i] * descCountMap[i] - deadlines[i], fast: false },
        { name: 'Composite10', getVal: (i) => cpMap[i] - deadlines[i] / (weights[i] + 1), fast: true },
        { name: 'Composite11', getVal: (i) => (descDurMap[i] + durations[i]) / (deadlines[i] + 1), fast: false },
        { name: 'Composite12', getVal: (i) => -deadlines[i] - durations[i], fast: false },
        { name: 'Composite13', getVal: (i) => -deadlines[i] + durations[i], fast: false },
        { name: 'Composite14', getVal: (i) => weights[i] * (cpMap[i] + descDurMap[i]) - deadlines[i], fast: true },
        { name: 'Composite15', getVal: (i) => cpMap[i] - 2 * deadlines[i] + 5 * weights[i], fast: false },
    ];

    const activeHeuristics = N <= 20000 ? heuristicGetters : heuristicGetters.filter(h => h.fast);

    const startTime = Date.now();
    let bestSchedule: ScheduleItem[] = [];
    let bestCost = Infinity;

    const heuristicResults: { priorityArray: Float64Array; cost: number }[] = [];

    for (const h of activeHeuristics) {
        const priorityArray = new Float64Array(N);
        for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            priorityArray[i] = h.getVal(i);
        }
        const res = runSimulation(priorityArray);
        heuristicResults.push({ priorityArray, cost: res.cost });

        if (res.cost < bestCost) {
            bestCost = res.cost;
            bestSchedule = res.schedule;
        }
    }

    const deterministicDuration = Date.now() - startTime;
    const TIME_LIMIT = Math.min(1200, Math.max(deterministicDuration * 2.5, 400));

    if (TIME_LIMIT > 0 && heuristicResults.length > 0) {
        heuristicResults.sort((a, b) => a.cost - b.cost);
        const topCandidates = heuristicResults.slice(0, Math.min(5, heuristicResults.length));
        const perturbedPriority = new Float64Array(N);

        while (Date.now() - startTime < TIME_LIMIT) {
            const cand = topCandidates[Math.floor(Math.random() * topCandidates.length)];
            const noiseScale = 0.2;

            for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                const base = cand.priorityArray[i];
                const mult = 1 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * noiseScale;
                const add = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.1;
                perturbedPriority[i] = base * mult + add;
            }

            const res = runSimulation(perturbedPriority);
            if (res.cost < bestCost) {
                bestCost = res.cost;
                bestSchedule = res.schedule;
            }
        }
    }

    // Safety fallback: schedule any tasks that did not run (e.g., due to cycles)
    if (bestSchedule.length < N) {
        const scheduledIds = new Set(bestSchedule.map(x => x.id));
        let maxEndTime = 0;
        for (const item of bestSchedule) {
            const t = taskList[idToIndex.get(item.id)!];
            maxEndTime = Math.max(maxEndTime, item.start + t.duration);
        }
        let machine = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            const t = taskList[i];
            if (!scheduledIds.has(t.id)) {
                bestSchedule.push({ id: t.id, start: maxEndTime, machine });
                maxEndTime += t.duration;
            }
        }
    }

    return JSON.stringify({ schedule: bestSchedule });
}

// Read input from stdin and solve
const input = fs.readFileSync(0, 'utf8');
const output = solve(input);
process.stdout.write(output);
